title: Associate Creative Director
description:
**About Remedy Edge Spain:**



Welcome to Remedy Edge Spain. We activate potential, amplify with creativity, and accelerate outcomes. Remedy Edge brings strategic thinking and bold communications to healthcare — cutting through the noise to move people and change results. We don't do comfortable. We do cutting edge. Join us and GET THE EDGE.


**About the role:**



We are looking for an experienced **Associate Creative Director (ACD)** to join our creative international team. In this role, you will lead the development of integrated healthcare campaigns, partnering with cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative, high\-quality creative solutions from concept through execution.


**Key responsibilities:**


* Develop strong creative concepts and integrated campaigns across multiple channels and formats.
* Lead the creative development of projects from initial concept through final execution, ensuring excellence in both visual and verbal communication.
* Transform complex healthcare and scientific information into clear, engaging, and impactful creative solutions.
* Partner with Creative Directors to define and maintain the creative vision and quality of the work.
* Lead, inspire and mentor creative teams, including art directors, copywriters and designers.
* Provide clear, constructive creative feedback that elevates the overall quality of the work.
* Collaborate closely with Strategy, Account, Medical and Production teams.
* Present and defend creative ideas confidently to internal stakeholders and clients.
* Manage multiple projects, priorities and deadlines without compromising creative standards.
* Take ownership of projects, proactively identify challenges and help drive work forward efficiently.


**About you:**



A **creative leader first and foremost**: someone with exceptional conceptual thinking, strong creative instincts, and the ability to recognize, develop and elevate great ideas.



Whether your roots are in **Art, Copy, or both**, you should be comfortable overseeing and guiding all aspects of the creative process, inspiring multidisciplinary teams and taking ownership of projects from concept to execution.



We're looking for someone with the ambition to push the work forward, the creative craft to make it exceptional, and the leadership skills to bring teams along the journey and deliver outstanding results.


**Skills \& Experience**


* **7\-8 years of creative experience in healthcare communications.**
* Strong background in either **Art Direction, Copywriting, or both**, with a portfolio demonstrating outstanding conceptual thinking and creative craft.
* Experience developing integrated campaigns across a variety of channels and touchpoints.
* Strong experience working with pharmaceutical, biotech, medical or health\-related brands.
* **Native\-level English is essential.**
* **Proven ability to lead creative teams and projects.**
* Excellent conceptual thinking, communication and presentation skills.
* Strong expertise in visual storytelling, narrative development, creative strategy and content creation.
* Ability to understand complex scientific information and translate it into compelling creative communications.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Good understanding of healthcare regulatory and compliance requirements.
* Collaborative, proactive and solution\-oriented mindset.

  


*Omnicom Health is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. We agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we're focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. We strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. Join us—we look forward to getting to know you. We will process your personal data in accordance with our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

Artificial Intelligence Engineer (Generative AI Engineer)
description:
Job Description
  
**Why Avanade? Because there’s literally no place like this**

We have two parent companies that give us a strong Microsoft ecosystem with space to be ourselves. People who thrive here are motivated, interested in learning and genuinely have a desire to be the best at what they do. If that sounds like you, then we’re the perfect match. You will have the opportunity to utilize the most advanced technology within the Microsoft ecosystem, collaborating with some of the world's largest and most renowned companies, as well as working alongside highly intelligent individuals. This environment allows you to make a significant impact on your career trajectory. If you are looking to enhance your skills and drive transformation within businesses, there is no better place to be.


**The EME AI Delivery Hub**

AI—and particularly **Generative AI** —is expected to profoundly impact every company over the coming years. Thanks to Microsoft and Avanade’s strategic investments in AI and OpenAI, we are uniquely positioned to help our clients become **AI\-first organizations** .


The **EME AI Delivery Hub** is an Iberia\-based nearshore delivery center serving European and Middle Eastern clients, specialized in end\-to\-end AI and Advanced Analytics solutions. By joining the Hub, you will be part of a delivery pod working in an agile setup, owning AI initiatives from **problem framing and data exploration to model development, deployment, and adoption** . You will work closely with clients, guiding them throughout their AI and GenAI transformation journey.


**Job Overview**

As a **Senior Analyst – AI \& Data Science** , you will design, develop, and deliver AI\- and data\-driven solutions that help our clients achieve measurable business outcomes. This role combines **strong Data Science foundations** with **hands\-on AI engineering** , including recent GenAI use cases.


You will work across the full data science lifecycle: **data exploration, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, and deployment** , while also contributing to modern AI solutions such as **LLM\-based applications, NLP, computer vision, and predictive analytics** , primarily on **Microsoft Azure** .


**Key Role Responsibilities**

**Day\-to\-day you will:**

* Design and deliver **end\-to\-end Data Science and AI solutions** , from business understanding and data exploration to model deployment and monitoring.
* Perform **exploratory data analysis (EDA)** , feature engineering, and data preprocessing on structured and unstructured datasets.
* Develop, train, evaluate, and optimize **machine learning and deep learning models** , selecting appropriate algorithms and validation strategies.
* Contribute to **Generative AI solutions** , including LLM\-based applications, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and applied NLP use cases.
* Translate business problems into analytical and ML formulations, clearly explaining trade\-offs and results to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Support the preparation of **client presentations, demos, and proposals** , articulating analytical insights and AI\-driven value.
* Stay up to date with the latest advancements in **Data Science, ML, DL, and GenAI** , and actively share knowledge within the team.
* Contribute to reusable assets such as **code templates, analytical frameworks, and internal training materials** .
* Collaborate with senior team members and architects to identify opportunities where advanced analytics and AI can transform client operations.

  
Qualification
  
**Key Role Skill \& Capability Requirements**

**Core Skills**

* Strong foundation in **Data Science and applied Machine Learning** , including supervised and unsupervised learning.
* Hands\-on experience with **ML/DL frameworks** (e.g., scikit\-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow or equivalent).
* Solid understanding of **model evaluation, validation, and performance metrics** .
* Experience working with **structured and unstructured data** , including text data for NLP use cases.
* Proficiency in **Python** for data analysis and ML development.

**AI \& GenAI**

* Experience or strong interest in **Generative AI** , including LLMs, embeddings, prompt engineering, and retrieval\-based approaches.
* Familiarity with **NLP, computer vision, forecasting, or optimization** use cases is a strong plus.
* Exposure to **Azure AI / Azure Machine Learning / Azure OpenAI** is highly valued.

**Professional Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems.
* Ability to communicate insights clearly in **English and Spanish** , both written and verbal.
* Comfortable working in **agile, client\-facing environments** .

**Preferred Education Background**

You likely hold a **bachelor’s and/or master’s degree in computer science** , Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.


**Preferred Years of Work Experience:**

* **3\+ years of applied experience** delivering Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI projects in real\-world environments.
* Experience over the last few years may be **heavily focused on GenAI** , but grounded in solid ML/DL and analytical fundamentals.

**What We offer**

* An accelerated and structured **training program on Microsoft Azure and AI services** .
* Hands\-on exposure to real client projects across **computer vision, NLP, forecasting, and GenAI (Azure OpenAI, chatbots, RAG)** .
* Continuous learning through certifications, mentoring, and internal communities of practice.

title: Social Art Director & Videographer - Madrid
description:
**¿Quiénes somos?**
-------------------


Somos una consultora internacional especializada en impulsar la evolución de los modelos de negocio de grandes y medianas empresas. Ayudamos a nuestros clientes a mejorar su competitividad conectando estrategia, comunicación, diseño, tecnología y datos, siempre con un enfoque práctico y orientado a generar impacto.


Contamos con un equipo de más de 2\.000 profesionales distribuidos en distintos países y trabajamos en proyectos end\-to\-end, acompañando a nuestros clientes desde la definición estratégica hasta la implementación, la medición y la optimización continua. Nuestro objetivo es transformar los datos en decisiones de negocio que generen resultados reales.


En esta ocasión, estamos colaborando con **Cosmic**, una empresa del grupo, en la búsqueda de talento para incorporar a su equipo y cubrir esta posición.

**¿Qué es Cosmic?**
-------------------

**Cosmic** es una agencia especializada en **Short Vertical Video**, el formato que domina plataformas como TikTok, Instagram Reels y YouTube Shorts. Como primer partner creativo de TikTok en Europa, ayuda a las marcas a conectar con sus audiencias a través de contenidos nativos, creativos y diseñados para maximizar su impacto.


Su equipo se encarga de diseñar, producir y optimizar contenidos que destacan en las plataformas donde hoy se generan las conversaciones y las tendencias, combinando creatividad, estrategia y un profundo conocimiento del ecosistema digital.

### **¿Qué buscamos?**

**¿Sabes que un buen TikTok no es un spot de 30 segundos puesto en vertical?**


Buscamos un/a **Social Art Director \& Videographer** con un ojo creativo brutal y una sensibilidad especial por el lenguaje de cada plataforma. Alguien que entienda qué hace que una idea funcione en social y que sea capaz de llevarla de principio a fin: **conceptualizarla, grabarla, editarla y convertirla en contenido que la gente quiera ver y compartir.**


No buscamos solo a alguien que sepa hacer vídeos bonitos. Buscamos a alguien que **entienda el lenguaje de internet, tenga criterio visual y sepa convertir una buena idea en contenido que funcione.**

### **Eres perfecto/a si**

* **Tienes 3\+ años de experiencia** en dirección de arte, diseño creativo o creación audiovisual, idealmente en agencia creativa, digital, productora o entorno social\-first.
* **Tu portfolio habla por ti.** Demuestra criterio visual, buenas ideas y, sobre todo, capacidad real para llevarlas a ejecución.
* **Tienes obsesión por el detalle.** Composición, fotografía, tipografía, color, ritmo… sabes que son los pequeños detalles los que hacen que una pieza pase de correcta a memorable.
* **Piensas en movimiento desde el principio.** No diseñas primero una pieza gráfica para convertirla después en vídeo: piensas en imagen, cámara, ritmo y narrativa desde el minuto uno.
* **Entiendes el lenguaje de cada plataforma.** Sabes que lo que funciona en TikTok no necesariamente funciona en Instagram o YouTube, y adaptas la idea sin perder su esencia.
* **Te mueves bien entre lo grande y lo rápido.** Puedes trabajar en una producción con todos los recursos o sacar adelante una pieza que tiene que estar publicada mañana.
* **Eres resourceful.** No necesitas una gran producción para hacer algo bueno: sabes sacar partido a un móvil, un equipo pequeño y los recursos que tengas a mano.
* **Eres proactivo/a.** Traes referencias, detectas tendencias, propones formatos y encuentras oportunidades incluso cuando nadie te ha dado todavía un brief.

### **¿Qué harás?**

* **Convertir ideas en contenido.** Conceptualizar y desarrollar ideas visuales y audiovisuales para campañas, contenido always\-on y oportunidades culturales en social.
* **Marcar la dirección visual.** Definir el look \& feel de contenidos y activaciones, construyendo una identidad reconocible sin caer en fórmulas o plantillas repetitivas.
* **Dar forma a las ideas.** Crear tratamientos visuales, referencias, moodboards, storyboards y planteamientos de realización que hagan que una idea cobre vida antes de llegar a producción.
* **Grabar y producir.** Coger una cámara o un smartphone y sacar adelante una pieza de principio a fin, adaptando los recursos a lo que necesita cada idea.
* **Resolver en modo social\-first.** Desde entrevistas y producto hasta creators, coberturas, contenido reactivo y formatos que necesitan salir rápido. Sabes moverte con soltura cuando el contexto cambia.
* **Editar y llevar las piezas hasta el final.** Montaje, ritmo, grafismo, motion, sonido y color, cuidando tanto el conjunto como cada detalle.
* **Pensar en cada plataforma.** Adaptar conceptos y piezas para TikTok, Reels, Stories, Shorts, YouTube, LinkedIn y otros formatos digitales, entendiendo qué funciona en cada entorno.
* **Trabajar pegado al equipo de contenido.** Colaborar con Content Manager y Social Intelligence para convertir tendencias, insights y oportunidades editoriales en ideas visuales que merezca la pena producir.
* **Experimentar con IA.** Incorporar herramientas generativas en tu proceso de ideación, preproducción y exploración visual, trabajando junto al AI Content Producer cuando la pieza requiera workflows más complejos.
* **Sacar lo mejor de los creators.** Dirigir a personas delante de cámara de forma natural, ágil y sin convertir cada grabación en un rodaje de película.
* **Defender tus ideas.** Presentar y argumentar conceptos y decisiones visuales ante equipos internos y clientes, sabiendo explicar no solo qué propones, sino por qué funciona.

### **Lo que tienes que dominar**

* **Portfolio con criterio.** Experiencia demostrable en creatividad social y audiovisual, con piezas que demuestren tanto buen ojo como capacidad de ejecución.
* **Cámara y móvil.** Capacidad profesional para grabar con cámara y smartphone, sabiendo elegir el equipo y el enfoque según lo que necesite cada pieza.
* **Lenguaje audiovisual.** Conocimientos sólidos de fotografía, composición, iluminación, encuadre, movimiento y narrativa audiovisual.
* **Herramientas de creación.** Dominio de Adobe Creative Cloud —Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere y After Effects— y soltura con herramientas ágiles como CapCut.
* **Código social.** Conocimiento profundo de formatos, duraciones, hooks, ritmo y códigos visuales y narrativos de TikTok, Instagram/Reels y YouTube/Shorts.
* **IA aplicada a la creatividad.** Familiaridad con herramientas de IA generativa y criterio para incorporarlas en la ideación, preproducción y producción audiovisual cuando realmente aporten valor.

**Cómo trabajas**
-----------------

* **Piensas y haces a la vez.** Te gusta conceptualizar, pero también coger la cámara, probar, grabar y resolver. No eres de los que se quedan en la idea.
* **Sabes que manda la plataforma.** Entiendes sus códigos, su ritmo y lo que hace que una pieza funcione en cada canal. No haces “un vídeo y luego lo adaptas”: piensas nativamente para cada plataforma.
* **Encuentras el equilibrio.** Sabes mantener la identidad de marca sin perder relevancia cultural ni convertir cada contenido en una pieza demasiado corporativa.
* **Eres proactivo/a.** Traes referencias, detectas tendencias, propones formatos y encuentras oportunidades sin esperar a que llegue un brief perfectamente cerrado.

**¿Te gustaría crecer con nosotros/as?**
----------------------------------------


Si buscas un entorno donde la creatividad, la comunicación y la estrategia se unen para generar un impacto real en el negocio, esta puede ser tu oportunidad.


En esta ocasión, te incorporarás a **Cosmic**, una empresa del grupo, donde formarás parte de un equipo que está redefiniendo la forma en la que las marcas conectan con sus audiencias a través del contenido en plataformas como TikTok, Instagram Reels y YouTube Shorts.


Si te apasionan los retos, la innovación y el entorno digital, ¡queremos conocerte!


En línea con nuestro compromiso con la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión, animamos a todas las personas a presentar su candidatura, especialmente a quienes forman parte de colectivos tradicionalmente infrarrepresentados, como las personas LGTBIQ\+ o las personas con discapacidad.

title: Head of Creative Content
description:
Hey there!
  

We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.



Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting\-edge technology and data\-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
  

  

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in \+55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.



Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award\-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?



To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar\-raisers with a hands\-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!  

  

Ready to be part of the experience?



Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission.

**Meet The Team**



Secret Media Network is a digital media group focused on recommending the perfect plans, discovering great places, sharing things to do, and providing relevant breaking news in various cities around the world. Our network is composed of Secret London, Secret Chicago, Secret LA, Secret NYC, Secret Sydney, Lisboa Secreta, Paris Secret, Madrid Secreto, Barcelona Secreta, and More!


**The Role**



The **Head of Branded Content** leads SMN's business generation area, driving the global partnerships ecosystem through strategic, creative, and data\-driven approaches that unlock new growth opportunities. This role connects creative strategy, content distribution, and commercial performance, ensuring every activation delivers measurable business outcomes through smart storytelling and precise timing across the funnel.



The Head will ensure all stories, partnerships, and activations align with strategic goals, uphold creative excellence, and drive revenue through new monetizable formats. They will rethink how we produce, distribute, and sell branded content to unlock new revenue streams and operational efficiencies across all markets.



Ultimately, the Head of Branded Content ensures that every piece of coverage, campaign, and content activation directly contributes to increasing event conversion and revenue, while maintaining the brand's voice, consistency, and global coherence.


**What You´ll Do**



Drive Commercial Growth Through Creative Solutions
* Lead the development of commercially driven content strategies that grow revenue across branded content, sponsorships, events, and integrated marketing programs.
* Partner with sales, creative, editorial, and product teams to develop compelling client solutions that combine storytelling with measurable business outcomes.
* Identify new revenue opportunities through innovative content formats, strategic partnerships, branded experiences, and emerging commercial products.

Lead Creative \& Business Transformation
* Shape the evolution of the content organization into a commercially minded creative business.
* Design workflows and ways of working that enable faster, more effective collaboration between creative, commercial, and editorial teams.
* Inspire and coach regional teams to think strategically about audience engagement, creative excellence, and commercial impact.

Champion Integrated Campaign Excellence
* Develop scalable frameworks for branded content and integrated campaigns from concept through execution.
* Bring an agency mindset to campaign development—connecting audience insights, creative ideas, and client objectives to deliver standout work.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, collaboration, and continuous creative improvement.

Optimize Performance \& Growth
* Use audience insights and performance data to inform creative decisions and continuously improve campaign effectiveness.
* Test new approaches, measure impact across the customer journey, and translate learnings into repeatable best practices.
* Balance creativity with commercial performance to maximize value for both audiences and partners.

Build Strategic Partnerships \& Innovation
* Cultivate relationships with brands, platforms, agencies, and strategic partners to unlock new business opportunities.
* Explore emerging content formats, digital products, and monetization models that strengthen long\-term growth.
* Turn successful pilots into scalable programs that can be adopted across global markets.

Enable Global Creative Consistency
* Champion high creative standards while ensuring brand consistency across markets.
* Share best practices, successful campaign models, and innovative thinking to elevate creative output globally.
* Build frameworks that allow local teams to create market\-relevant work while maintaining a unified global brand.


**Who You Are**



You are the ideal candidate if you bring the following key qualifications:


* English proficiency; additional languages are a plus.
* 7\+ years of experience in branded content, creative strategy, digital media, or related fields, with 3\+ years in team leadership.
* Strong commercial and strategic mindset, with a proven ability to build, package, and sell content solutions that drive revenue.
* Expertise in digital platforms and social media ecosystems, and a deep understanding of how content performs across the funnel.
* Hands\-on experience with partnerships, including brands, agencies, and media/platform partners.
* Data\-driven approach, with the ability to turn insights into decisions, optimizations, and new monetization opportunities.
* Outstanding communication and presentation skills, able to inspire teams and influence stakeholders.
* Ability to rethink workflows and processes, aligning creative output with commercial objectives.
* Solid understanding of optimization technologies and AI\-driven processes, workflow automation, and performance outcomes.


**Why You´ll Love it Here**


* Attractive compensation package.
* Opportunity to have a real impact in a high\-growth global category leader.
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences.
* Work in a location in the heart of the city, with possible travel across our markets.
* Home\-office friendly.

* Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!
* Private health and dental insurance, as well as other benefits, including flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee.
* Wellhub membership.

title: Head of Design, AI-First
description:
**Own the design function for a $1Billion\+ brand. Transform how we build with AI.** 




  





**Total Annual Package:** 
 Up to USD $181,500 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base)
 



**Location:** 
 Remote (Global)
 



**Growth path** 
 from here is VP Design → Chief Design Officer. What takes 4\-5 years elsewhere can happen in 1\-2 years here for high performers.
 



  





**We've been AI\-first since December 2023:** 
 Every design proposal ships with an AI review link, and Figma AI runs in our live production pipeline, shipping real work. You'd start where most teams are still trying to get.
 



  





*This position is remote, with the option to work from our Dubai office (with 0% income tax), if preferred (relocation and visa sponsorship support available).* 




  





**Role Overview** 




 Puffy, a market\-leading, nine\-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Head of Design to turn our end\-to\-end web design from a sequential production queue into a fast, AI\-native operation. You will build on our existing AI adoption by establishing consistent workflows, prompt infrastructure, quality controls and system governance that let high\-quality design work ship at volume without extending timelines. While you own the visual and structural execution of the site, you will partner closely with the CRO team, which owns experimentation, including test hypotheses and the conversion roadmap.
 



  





**The Career Accelerator** 




 You will have the rare opportunity to take on a broad scope of work with unmatched autonomy.
 



  




* **The scope is scarce:** 
 very few Heads of Design get simultaneous ownership over the design system, the AI toolchain, the design roadmap and accessibility standards while leading a team of three as a hands\-on player coach and reporting directly to the VP, Digital Experience \& Conversion. This is not a role where you just review other people's mockups and forward them to engineering. Instead, you are building the operating system for the entire design function.
* **Your first 12 months:** 
 rebuild the design workflow from sequential to agile, with kickoff huddles and a 40% reduction in time from design concept to development handoff. Build the prompt library and review workflow covering product copy, FAQs, size/fit guidance, policy explainers, and localized variants. Design the UI patterns for conversational search, guided finders, and PDP Q\&A alongside engineering. Own the recommendation surfaces — placements, card density, "why this" microcopy — and validate them with staged rollouts. title: Founding Creative Director
description:
**Meet Siena**
--------------


Siena is the The Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.
  

  

It runs as a connected multi\-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

**The team**
------------


We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.


We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.


If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading.

**The role**
------------


Siena is building the intelligence layer for CX, and we're about to launch several products in quick succession. We are not looking for someone to execute a brief well. We are looking for the person whose taste the rest of the company gets measured against: someone who looks at a landing page and can't not have an opinion, who would rather kill a launch than ship something mediocre, and who has owned creative direction before, not just contributed to it.


If you need a creative director above you setting the vision, a team to delegate to on day one, or a slow, considered, one\-project\-at\-a\-time pace, stop reading now. This isn't that job.


If you're the person other designers already defer to on taste, continue.


**This is a craft title. Not a headcount title.**
-------------------------------------------------


You will ship personally for the first year and set the bar for everyone who comes after. Over time you will build a small internal agency, two to three people across design, motion, and content, that can brief, position, and launch without outside help.

* Narrative and positioning across every launch \- design as strategy, not decoration
* Every artifact that goes to market: landing pages, launch video, decks, social
* The design system, from v3 onward
* The bar, full stop \- if it ships under the Siena name, you made it or you signed off on it

**What it takes to be in the room**
-----------------------------------

* **Taste, above everything, and evidence you can defend it.** Specific, defended opinions about what's good and why.
* **A track record of owning creative direction, not just contributing to it.** Agency or in\-house, brand refresh or full launch \- you've been the person whose call was final, not the one waiting on notes.
* **Narrative thinking.** Design as positioning. You should already have a point of view on how a brand like Siena should be positioned, not just how it should look.
* **AI as a working tool, not a threat to your taste.** You've already built something with AI \- an app, a prototype, a mockup \- and you want to get technical enough to ship a landing page yourself within a year. Anti\-AI is disqualifying.
* **Range that travels.** Your background doesn't have to be SaaS. Fashion, art, consumer brand, editorial \- what matters is whether your taste holds up somewhere new.
* **A pattern of shipping in chaos, not around it.** Multiple launches in flight, feedback that moves in hours not weeks. If your best work happens on a slow, protected timeline, that's useful information \- it's just not this role.

**Why this is worth it**
------------------------


You're not joining a design team to fit into. You're setting the taste bar for a company that's about to be a lot more visible, a lot faster than most companies get that chance.


This is intense \- real ownership, real launches, a founder team that reviews your work directly and moves at the pace you'd expect from that. It's also one of the rare creative seats where nothing you make gets diluted by committee before it ships.


If that sounds like the room you've been trying to get into, we want to talk to you.


If it sounds like too much scrutiny too fast, this isn't a knock on you \- it just isn't this role.

**Why Siena?**
--------------

* **Real ownership.** You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.
* **Work that ships and matters.** What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.
* **A category we are creating.** The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting\-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.
* **A team that respects your judgment.** Globally distributed, async\-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.
* **Great salary plus equity or stock grants.** Own a piece of what you build.
* **Learning budget.** If you are growing, so are we.
* **AI\-fluency by default.** Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

**Our values**
--------------


The people who thrive here are curious, customer\-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback—both giving and receiving it—because they care more about getting things right than being polite.


They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.

**Our approach to AI**
----------------------


The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents \- some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.


Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.


At Siena, we’re not just looking for people who can do a job. We’re looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that’s you, we look forward to your application.


We use AI\-assisted screening tools as part of our hiring process. All decisions are made by humans. You can request a human\-only review at talent@siena.cx.

*Siena provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.*

title: Creative Director- Interior Design
description:
1\.1 The Creative Director is the custodian of EVA Interiors’ creative vision, design quality, and aesthetic integrity across all interior design, architectural, and FF\&E outputs.
 



 1\.2 The role exists to institutionalize creativity at EVA Interiors by transforming creative vision into clear standards, guidelines, and governance frameworks, ensuring consistency, excellence, and repeatable quality at scale.
 



 1\.3 The Creative Director ensures that EVA’s creative output reflects a luxury positioning that is innovative, disciplined, commercially viable, and execution\-ready, while continuously evolving to remain relevant and distinctive in the market.
 



  





**2\.1 Creative Vision, Guidelines \& Governance** 



* The Creative Director defines, documents, and continuously refines EVA Interiors’ creative philosophy and design language, ensuring that spatial principles, material hierarchy, detailing standards, colour strategies, and FF\&E integration are formalised within approved governance frameworks.
* The role ensures that all creative outputs demonstrably comply with documented standards, and that any deviation is formally identified, evaluated, and addressed through structured corrective governance mechanisms rather than informal tolerance.
* The Creative Director maintains executive oversight of all design\-related SOPs to ensure sustained alignment between creative integrity, structured workflows, and disciplined project execution.
* Creative standards shall be applied consistently across all projects and shall be subject to continuous refinement informed by documented review outcomes, performance analysis, and institutional learning.



**2\.2 Measurable Creative Output \& First Time\-Right Accountability** 



* The Creative Director is accountable for ensuring that creative leadership translates into measurable, predictable, and disciplined quality outcomes.
* A minimum first\-submission approval rate of (80%) shall be maintained across formal design reviews, unless deviations are supported by documented root cause analysis and clearly defined corrective action plans.
* Review cycles shall remain within agreed revision thresholds. Recurrent rework patterns shall trigger structured evaluation, accountability review, and systemic improvement measures rather than normalization.
* All scheduled creative reviews constitute mandatory leadership obligations. Attendance shall be maintained consistently. In cases of unavoidable absence, formal delegation of documented decision authority shall be established in advance. Any missed review shall require written explanation and rescheduling within (24\) hours.
* Approvals, rejections, and required design modifications shall be communicated within agreed review timelines to prevent avoidable production delays or adverse impact on project revenue realization, forecast integrity, or client confidence.
* Review feedback and formal approval decisions shall be issued within (24\) hours of the review session unless otherwise formally justified in writing.
* Creative authority within EVA shall operate as a performance accelerator and governance safeguard, never as a constraint on disciplined production.



**2\.3 Structured Review Cadence \& Institutional Discipline** 



* The Creative Director is responsible for maintaining a defined, documented, and consistently executed creative governance rhythm across the organization.
* At minimum, one structured Creative Review session shall be led weekly, and one formal Quality Retrospective shall be conducted monthly. Each session shall produce documented minutes, clearly assigned accountability, and tracked follow\-up actions.
* Recurring quality deviations, review inefficiencies, or creative inconsistencies shall be translated into updated guidelines, strengthened enforcement protocols, or revised governance standards.
* Creative governance within EVA shall be cyclical, documented, and continuously reinforced to ensure institutional maturity and sustained quality performance.



**2\.4 Commercial Alignment \& Revenue Protection** 



* The Creative Director is accountable for ensuring that creative decisions are aligned with approved project timelines, revenue realization schedules, forecast commitments, and overall project profitability.
* The Creative Director shall collaborate with Planning and Operations to ensure that creative timelines and review cycles are realistically reflected in revenue forecasts, milestone commitments, and execution sequencing.
* Creative refinement shall not introduce avoidable delays that negatively affect revenue progression, cash flow timing, forecast accuracy, or client confidence.
* Where creative ambition presents potential timeline, cost, or commercial exposure, such implications shall be proactively identified, formally evaluated, and resolved in coordination with project leadership and Executive Management.
* Design excellence within EVA is expected to unlock commercial value while preserving disciplined control over schedule, cost, and revenue integrity.



**2\.5 Escalation \& Risk Management Obligation** 



* Any creative, quality, review\-related, or design governance issue that may materially impact project timelines, revenue realization, client confidence, or brand reputation shall be escalated to Executive Management within (24\) hours.
* Escalation shall include a documented impact assessment, root cause analysis, and proposed mitigation strategy.
* No material creative risk shall remain unaddressed, undocumented, or without executive visibility.



**2\.6 Enforcement Authority \& Team Performance Accountability** 



* The Creative Director is responsible for enforcing compliance with approved design standards, governance frameworks, and review discipline across all design personnel.
* Where repeated non\-compliance, quality deviation, review absence, or execution inconsistency occurs, the Creative Director shall initiate structured corrective action in coordination with Executive Management and Human Resources.
* Delegation of responsibilities does not eliminate accountability for creative outcomes. Enforcement authority is inherent to the role and integral to its seniority, Sustained failure to meet defined governance cadence, revision thresholds, escalation timelines, or documented enforcement obligations shall constitute performance non\-compliance and shall be subject to formal performance review in accordance with company policy.



**2\.7 Innovation \& Strategic Creative Development** 



* The Creative Director leads structured innovation initiatives designed to enhance differentiation, strengthen quality standards, and improve execution efficiency.
* Innovation must be practical, buildable, commercially responsible, and clearly linked to brand positioning or project value.
* Creative experimentation must be governed, documented, and selectively integrated into live projects where appropriate.



**2\.8 FF\&E Library Governance \& Design Asset Control** 



* The Creative Director holds strategic ownership of EVA’s FF\&E Library and ensures that it remains curated, quality\-controlled, commercially viable, and aligned with EVA’s luxury positioning.
* All additions shall meet defined standards of originality, feasibility, execution readiness, and brand coherence.
* The FF\&E Library shall function as an active production, quality\-control, and creative governance asset supporting consistency and efficiency across projects.



**2\.9 Leadership Presence \& Accessibility** 



* The Creative Director is expected to maintain consistent on\-site leadership presence during critical review cycles, high\-visibility project phases, and production\-intensive periods.
* Leadership availability and accessibility are structural expectations of the role. Remote work arrangements shall not compromise review cadence, enforcement discipline, team accessibility, or executive responsiveness and require formal approval in accordance with company policy.
* Creative leadership within EVA requires visible authority, sustained engagement, and operational presence commensurate with the seniority of the role.



  





**Please share your CV and your portfolio to hrhead@evainteriors.ae**

title: Freelance Creative Director
description:
**About Tigrett Agency**

Tigrett Agency is a full\-service creative advertising agency based in Scottsdale, Arizona. We solve unique business problems for local and national brands through strategic thinking, strong creative, and work designed to perform.

Our capabilities span brand development, advertising, creative production, digital marketing, social media, web design and development, and everything required to bring an integrated campaign to life.

We’re looking for a Freelance / Part\-Time Creative Director to join our team and help lead creative for a growing consumer brand account in the golf space.

Golf industry experience is a plus, but it isn’t a requirement. What matters more is an understanding of consumer brands, culture, advertising, and how to turn a strong strategy into creative people actually want to engage with.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a Creative Director who is every bit as comfortable making the work as they are directing it.

This is not a role for someone who only wants to review concepts, manage creatives, or provide high\-level direction. You’ll be expected to roll up your sleeves and contribute directly—from developing campaign concepts and designing creative to writing headlines, building decks, directing shoots, and shaping content across channels.

You’re a conceptual thinker with strong visual instincts and enough range to move fluidly between graphic design, art direction, photo and video, copywriting, social content, and advertising.

You understand that a great campaign is bigger than a single ad. You can establish the creative idea, translate it across the customer journey, and build a cohesive visual and verbal system that works across paid media, organic social, web, retail, product launches, influencer content, sales materials, and brand experiences.

For our immediate needs, you’ll help develop and execute creative for a consumer products brand within the golf industry, working closely with Tigrett’s strategy, media, production, and account teams.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Lead creative concept development for integrated advertising campaigns and product launches.
* Turn marketing strategy and creative briefs into compelling campaign platforms, big ideas, visual systems, and executions.
* Personally create work, including graphic design, campaign layouts, social creative, digital advertising, presentations, storyboards, moodboards, and other visual assets.
* Develop headlines, campaign copy, scripts, social content, product messaging, and other brand communications.
* Establish and maintain a consistent visual and verbal direction across channels.
* Art direct and help execute photo and video productions, including shot development, treatments, storyboards, talent direction, and on\-set creative direction.
* Concept short\-form video, social\-first content, paid\-media creative, product demonstrations, and lifestyle content.
* Partner with designers, photographers, videographers, editors, copywriters, strategists, media buyers, developers, and outside production partners when additional resources are needed.
* Develop presentation\-quality concepts and pitch creative internally and directly to clients.
* Think through how a central campaign idea translates across paid media, organic social, influencer marketing, PR, web, email, retail, events, and sales channels.
* Collaborate with paid\-media teams to develop creative variations designed for testing, optimization, and performance.
* Participate in strategic brainstorming, campaign planning, creative brief development, and client presentations.
* Manage multiple projects, timelines, and deliverables without sacrificing the quality of the work.
* Maintain a high creative standard while understanding when something needs another round—and when it simply needs to ship.

**What We’re Looking For**

5\+ years of creative experience, ideally within an advertising agency, creative studio, consumer brand, or similarly fast\-paced environment.

A portfolio that demonstrates both strong conceptual thinking and exceptional execution. We want to see the ideas behind the work as much as the finished product.

**You should have:**

* Strong graphic design and visual communication skills.
* A sophisticated understanding of typography, layout, composition, branding, and art direction.
* Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and/or comparable professional creative tools.
* Experience concepting and directing photography and video.
* Strong copywriting skills with the ability to develop campaign headlines, scripts, social copy, product messaging, and brand voice.

title: Creative Director
description:
**The Problem**
---------------


Flock's creative group is expanding as the company raises its standard of visual storytelling and campaign execution across brand, film, and digital experiences. This momentum creates a need for unified creative leadership to turn complex technology and public safety outcomes into compelling, human\-centered narratives. You will own that direction, driving the creative concept, visual identity, and craft bar across design, film, and motion.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* Direct integrated campaigns, product launch narratives, and flagship brand films from initial concept through final delivery.
* Define and maintain the visual, cinematic, and editorial standards across design, motion, and video production to build a recognizable creative signature.
* Lead and mentor multidisciplinary craft teams, guiding discipline leads in art direction, storytelling, and creative critique.
* Establish operational systems, including reference libraries, templates, and production guidelines, that elevate quality while improving delivery speed.
* Partner with brand strategy and production leadership to translate executive goals into clear creative briefs and execution plans.

**What This Role is Not**
-------------------------

* This is not a hands\-off review role, you will actively shape concepts, guide edits, direct art execution, and refine details across all mediums.
* This isn't a high\-volume template production management job, your main focus is establishing concept quality and narrative depth.
* This is not an isolated brand strategy position, you will work directly alongside production and cross\-functional teams to ship live campaigns.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Proven track record leading multidisciplinary creative teams across art direction, design, motion, and cinematic film production.
* Deep portfolio demonstrating high\-craft visual design alongside narrative documentary or high\-paced commercial storytelling.
* Advanced fluency in the complete production lifecycle, including typography, editing pace, color grading, sound design, and finishing standards.
* Experience setting practical brand guidelines, design systems, and creative review frameworks for internal teams and agency partners.
* Ability to direct campaigns that balance emotional human narrative with clear technical product messaging.

**Compensation**
----------------


In this role, you'll receive a starting salary between $200,000 and $250,000 as well as Flock Stock Options. Base salary is determined by job\-related experience, education/training, as well as market indicators. Your recruiter will discuss this in depth with you during our first chat.

**Why Flock**
=============

Every community deserves to be safe. Flock builds the technology that makes that real: last year we supported over 1 million criminal investigations and helped locate more than 10,000 missing people. We're 1,700 people building the impossible with over $1B in funding, and the expectations are high on purpose. If you want a role where the stakes are real and the pace matches, this is it.


Some problems get solved faster in the same room, so we prioritize candidates in Atlanta and Boston. Hub\-based roles mean real in\-person time with your coworkers. Remote roles exist, and when a posting is open to remote work, it says so.


The impossible takes every kind of mind. One last thing. All legitimate communication from Flock comes from an email ending in @flocksafety.com or noreply@ashbyhq.com. You will lead the vision for breakthrough, culturally resonant campaigns with social at the core. You know how to turn insights into ideas, ideas into movements, and movements into measurable business impact. ### **What You'll Bring**


* 8–12\+ years of agency experience with a portfolio demonstrating award\-worthy, social\-first, campaign\-driven work

* Exceptional creative judgment across art, copy, and storytelling, with a high bar for craft and execution

title: Art Director, Apparel Graphics
description:
**Role:** Art Director
  

**Team:** Graphic Design


**Scope:** Individual Contributor, P4


**Years of Experience:** 5\+


**Location:** Ventura, CA (Hybrid)  



  

As the Art Director for Apparel Graphics, you will help shape and execute the visual direction of graphics across Patagonia apparel collections. You will translate seasonal ideas, brand storytelling and product needs into original artwork, typography, color and graphic systems that are compelling, consistent and ready for production. Working closely with product line managers, designers, developers and marketing, you will guide creative work from concept through final execution. Your ability to create meaningful, durable graphics and explore responsible applications will support Patagonia’s work to save our home planet.


**What You’ll Do**

* Create and art direct seasonal apparel graphics that express Patagonia’s brand identity, product stories and creative point of view across assigned categories.
* Translate seasonal themes and creative briefs into original artwork, typography, color strategies, trims and cohesive graphic concepts.
* Partner with Product Line Management, apparel designers, development and marketing teams to align graphics with product, brand, production and sales timelines.
* Balance hands\-on design with art direction, providing clear feedback to internal designers, external creatives and agency or freelance partners as assigned.
* Prepare artwork for screen print, embroidery and specialty applications, working with graphic development partners to ensure creative intent, quality and production feasibility.
* Review and approve artwork strike\-offs and revisions, resolving creative or technical issues while keeping work on schedule.
* Support artist commissioning, artwork licensing and related cost discussions when projects require external creative partners.
* Research cultural, artistic, market and competitive influences while protecting Patagonia’s brand heritage and avoiding trend\-for\-trend’s\-sake design.
* Explore opportunities to improve materials, techniques and graphic applications with consideration for quality, longevity and environmental impact.
* Present concepts and creative rationale clearly, manage multiple projects and maintain consistent communication throughout the design process.

**Who You Are**

* **Conceptual** : You can turn an open\-ended theme or product story into a clear, original visual idea.
* **Hands\-On** : You enjoy making the work as much as guiding it and can move comfortably between concept, design and refinement.
* **Collaborative** : You build trust across creative, product and development partners and use feedback to strengthen the work.
* **Discerning** : You bring strong taste and judgment in illustration, typography, color, composition and brand expression.
* **Practical** : You understand that successful creative work must also meet production, quality, cost and timeline requirements.
* **Curious** : You stay connected to art, culture, apparel and emerging creative practices while maintaining an authentic brand perspective.
* **Clear** : You communicate creative intent, feedback and decisions in ways that help others move the work forward.
* **Mission\-Aligned** : You care about responsible design, product longevity and Patagonia’s purpose to save our home planet.

**Experience You Bring**

* 5\+ years of apparel graphics, graphic design, art direction or closely related creative experience, with a portfolio demonstrating concept development and successful final execution.
* Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, fine art, industrial arts or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and other relevant design tools.
* Strong capabilities in original artwork, illustration, typography, color strategy and visual storytelling.
* Working knowledge of apparel graphics production, including screen print, embroidery, trims, specialty applications and artwork preparation.
* Experience partnering with product creation or development teams and responding to technical, cost, quality and timeline constraints.
* Experience art directing or providing creative feedback to internal or external designers, illustrators or artists.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast\-moving, collaborative environment.
* Experience with outdoor, sport, lifestyle or global consumer brands is preferred.
* Familiarity with responsible design practices, innovative art applications, artist licensing or outdoor communities is a plus.

**Hiring Range** : $122,900 \- $140,000 USD Annual


At Patagonia, pay ranges are assigned to a job based on the location specific market median of similar jobs according to 3rd party salary benchmark surveys. Individual pay within that range can vary for several reasons including skills/capabilities, experience, and available budget.


**Benefits**

Patagonia offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, retirement and leave of absence plans. Benefit plans may vary slightly depending on the nature of your employment.


**Workplace Location Overview**

This position is Hybrid, with a standard schedule of Tuesday \- Thursday on\-site and remote work on other days. Occasional additional office visits may be required for team events or critical meetings.


**Employee Conduct**  

It is the responsibility of every employee to contribute to a positive, inclusive work environment through cooperative and professional interactions with co\-workers, customers and vendors.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other factors prohibited by law.

With over €2 billion in assets under management, we operate 800\+ chalets, villas and apartments under 3 consumer brands: Emerald Stay (our 4\* brand), Bo House (our 5\* brand) and Verbier Exclusive (our Palace brand). Our guests can discover our properties in more than 25 exceptional destinations across Europe and North America. We are a fast\-growing company generating around €100M in annual revenue, backed by more than €50M raised from top\-tier investors. Join us at a pivotal moment, with the ambition and the means to keep raising the bar.  

  

We are looking for a talented **part\-time People Director (50\-60%)** to join our dynamic team, at our Barcelona office. In this role, you will be exposed to an international group spanning various business units, where your ability to protect and nurture our culture and to excel at recruitment will be absolutely key to your success.

* Act as HR Business Partner for all companies in the group.
* Ensure HR monitoring and compliance.
* Be accountable for the OKRs process, together with our Chief of Staff.
* Run the annual employee survey and propose an annual HR plan based on the results.

* Handle key individual HR matters and HR situations that escalate.

Depending on priorities as well as your bandwidth, skills and interest, you may be involved in other projects, in line with your qualifications.

* Employment start: as soon as possible.
* Reporting to the CEO (Maxime Friess) and COO (Laurent Lacourt).
* Position based in Barcelona.
* Occasional travel across our entities and destinations, as needed

	+ Step 1: screening call for selected candidates.

	+ Step 3: video interview with our Chief People Officer and our HR Manager.
	+ Step 4: video interview with our COO.
	+ Step 5: video interview with our CEO.
	+ Step 6: references check.

 **ABOUT YOU**

**We’d love to hear from you if…**

* You have solid senior HR / People experience, ideally across several entities or countries: at least 5 years.
* You are an entrepreneur at heart and have prior experience at a fast\-growing startup \- we expect you to be proactive and constructive at all times; you thrive in a fast\-paced environment.

* You are a natural people leader who builds trust and handles confidential matters with discretion.
* You have a good working knowledge of labour and employment frameworks (France and Spain a plus).
* You are comfortable steering with data, dashboards and KPIs, and strong with digital tools.

**Oh, we’ve got perks...**

description:

You will provide the structure, shared foundations, and governance that enable our four business lines to deliver AI solutions with speed, quality, and precision.
**Job Description**
===================


**The mission of the AI Operations Leader within our office is to:**


* **Enable Execution:** Facilitate the execution of Business Line long\-term strategy (LTS) plans, ensuring they move at speed and with high impact.
* **Ensure Operational Excellence:** Define and manage the day\-to\-day mechanisms that deliver consistent quality, ensuring that every AI initiative is executed with discipline and minimal risk.
* **Scale Through Capability:** Act as the operational backbone of our center of excellence, transforming our strategy into repeatable processes that allow our businesses to own and scale their AI delivery effectively.

**What you’ll be doing**


* **Facilitating business execution:** You will act as the primary partner for our four business lines. Your focus is on clearing the path for them to execute their long\-term strategic AI plans, ensuring they have the support and resources needed to reach their goals quickly and effectively.
* **Defining the operational heartbeat:** You will establish the "cadence" of AI delivery—regular reviews, progress tracking, and feedback loops—that keep our business lines aligned and moving forward.
* **Providing a shared foundation:** You will lead the development of the "common ground"—the standards, tools, and shared platforms—that allow our business units to build AI solutions without having to solve the same infrastructure or governance problems in isolation.
* **Driving speed and quality:** You will help our business teams balance the need for rapid delivery with the need for high\-quality, reliable output. By implementing clear, lightweight ways of working, you will help teams avoid common pitfalls and keep projects on track.
* **Managing risk by design:** Instead of treating risk as a hurdle to be jumped at the end, you will help teams bake it into their processes from day one. You will ensure that Responsible AI and security practices are built into the workflow, protecting the business while maintaining momentum.
* **Ensuring strategic alignment:** You will oversee our portfolio to ensure that the work happening across the business lines stays tethered to ELEC’s overarching enterprise priorities. You will help teams focus their energy on the initiatives that provide the greatest return.
* **Supporting the transition:** We are working toward a future where our business lines are fully empowered to lead their own AI delivery. You will guide this evolution, scaling our efforts today to build a sustainable, business\-led model for 2030\.
* **Driving adoption and upskilling:** You will champion the human side of our transformation by leading efforts to upskill our workforce. In close coordination with ELEC HR, the GE Vernova Corporate Learning team, the ELEC CTO office, and Business Line AI teams, you will design and adapt training programs that directly address the unique missions and practical needs of our ELEC teams. By building targeted AI literacy and specialized expertise, you will ensure our people are empowered to adopt new tools and maximize the value of AI in their specific daily work.

**What you bring to the team**


* **A commitment to partnership:** You have a track record of supporting business units in achieving their strategic goals. You view your role as a service to the business lines, not as a central authority.
* **A "get it done" mindset:** You understand that the best strategy is only valuable if it can be executed. You are experienced in guiding complex initiatives through to delivery while maintaining high standards.
* **Balanced judgment:** You know how to provide enough guidance to ensure consistency across the company without creating unnecessary red tape that slows teams down.
* **Technical and business fluency:** You can communicate clearly with both technical delivery teams and business leadership, ensuring that everyone understands the goals and the path to achieving them.
* **Proven reliability:** You have a history of managing programs or operations where speed, quality, and risk management were all critical to success.

**How we’ll measure success**


* **LTS Execution:** Our business lines are successfully hitting the milestones set out in their long\-term AI strategy plans.
* **Operational Speed:** We have reduced the time it takes to get from an idea to a working, value\-driving solution.
* **Risk \& Quality:** Our AI initiatives consistently meet our internal standards for security and responsibility, with minimal friction.
* **Business Impact:** Every AI project we support can clearly demonstrate its contribution to ELEC’s business performance.

**Skills \& Academic Requirements**


To lead this transformation effectively, you will need a blend of technical understanding, operational discipline, and the ability to influence people.


* **Academic \& Professional Background:**
	+ **Degree:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

### **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**


* Understanding of GCP, ICH, and FDA guidelines and regulations applicable to conduct clinical research.

description:
**About the opportunity**
=========================



We are seeking a seasoned Senior Product Manager to join the "Intelligent Operations Platforms" (IOP) segment. In this role, you will drive the development of AI solutions \- spanning both Machine Learning and Generative AI \- that empower our teams and help N26 lead the financial industry through technology.



Our AI Products team acts as a central hub of innovation. We don't just build features; we build and manage AI capabilities that allow every other part of the bank \- from Financial Crime and Risk to Growth and Marketing \- to become smarter. You will work at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and real\-world banking, turning sophisticated models into scalable products that improve efficiency, compliance and the customer experience.


### **In this role, you will:**


* **Partner Strategically with Senior Product Leadership:** Work closely with cross\-functional PM leads to shape and align your domain roadmap with N26's broader company\-wide AI strategy, maintaining full autonomy over complex, high\-stakes workstreams.
* **Drive Measurable Business Impact:** Focus on high\-impact areas, including automating back\-office Operations, enhancing real\-time fraud and AML detection (FinCrime), and personalizing B2C customer growth and marketing journeys.
* **Own the Production AI Lifecycle:** Lead end to end delivery for complex Machine Learning and GenAI initiatives—moving from initial hypothesis, data scoping, and model evaluation harnesses to production deployment and post\-launch monitoring.

* **Balance Velocity with Banking Rigor:** Manage day\-to\-day delivery, maintaining a healthy balance between launching innovative AI capabilities and upholding the strict security, auditability, data privacy, and reliability standards expected of a regulated bank.

### **What you need to be successful:**


#### **Background:**


* 5\+ years of Product Management experience in a technology\-driven environment, with a proven track record of owning and shipping production\-grade AI/ML capabilities.
* **Real\-World GenAI \& Agentic Systems Production Experience:** Hands\-on experience taking GenAI products from concept to live production. You must have direct experience building with concepts like Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic workflows (ReAct framework, state/memory management, function\-calling), and multi\-agent orchestration systems. (Note: Utilizing off\-the\-shelf AI productivity tools is not sufficient; we require a track record of building customer\-facing or platform products powered by AI).

Note: Pure B2B background with low customer scale does not fit the high\-volume requirements of this role.
* **Full AI/ML Specialization:** Comprehensive expertise navigating the full AI product lifecycle, including problem scoping, target metric definition, data ingestion/labeling, model training/fine\-tuning, evaluation framework design, deployment, latency optimization, and continuous retraining.

#### **Skills:**


* **Traditional ML Foundation \+ GenAI Evolution:** A background grounded in traditional Machine Learning methodologies (classification, regression, ranking/recommendation engines) paired with hands\-on expertise in modern LLM architecture.
* **Deep Technical Literacy \& Architecture Evaluation:** Strong grasp of AI technical fundamentals, with the ability to evaluate trade\-offs between Large Language Models (LLMs) and deterministic ML/rule\-based logic across cost, inference latency, explainability, and accuracy.
* **Data\-Driven \& Model Evaluation Mindset:** Proficiency in defining, tracking, and translating offline model evaluation metrics (precision, recall, F1, confidence thresholds, hallucination rates) into tangible business KPIs and operational ROI.
* **Cross\-Functional \& Regulatory Awareness:** Strong collaboration skills within Agile environments, coupled with an understanding of financial services constraints (GDPR, data residency, EU AI Act, risk governance, and security controls).

#### **Traits:**


* **Pragmatic Action Bias:** A focus on high\-velocity execution and value creation, knowing how to balance model perfection with pragmatic, incremental shipping in a fast\-paced environment.
* **Production Reliability:** Uncompromising standards for system resiliency, ensuring all AI\-driven platform features are robust enough for a global banking infrastructure.
* **Technical Collaboration:** Comfortable speaking the same technical language as Principal Data Scientists and Platform Engineers while translating complex model behavior into clear updates for non\-technical leadership.

### **What's in it for you:**


* Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe's most talked about disruptors.
* Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness \& wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
* As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
* Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
* A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies \- all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and backgrounds.
* A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

### **Who we are**



N26 has reimagined banking for today's digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it's how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.



We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.



We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500\-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.


**Sounds good? Apply now for this position.**

We recognize that our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring to our workforce. We strive to build talented and diverse teams to drive our business success and empower our people to reach their full potential.



We genuinely welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. **Who are we?**  

  

EIT Urban Mobility is an initiative of the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), a body of the European Union and Europe's largest network for transport innovation in cities.

  

Our mission is to accelerate change towards a sustainable model of urban mobility and liveable urban spaces. We connect public and private actors and provide them with access to markets, talent, finance and knowledge.

  

Using cities as living labs, our industry, research and university partners will demonstrate how new technologies can work to solve real problems in real cities by transporting people, goods and waste in smarter ways.

Our EIT Urban Mobility Academy is a collaborative arena for lifelong learning, helping to build critical capabilities for innovation and transformation. https://www.eiturbanmobility.eu/academy/

title: Senior Concept Artist
description:
**Company Description** **Join The Game!**


Leader in the development and publishing of games, Gameloft® has established itself as a pioneer in the industry, creating innovative gaming experiences for over 20 years. Gameloft creates games for all digital platforms, from mobile to cross\-platform titles for PC and consoles. Gameloft operates its own established franchises such as Asphalt®, Dragon Mania Legends, Modern Combat and Dungeon Hunter and also partners with major rights holders including LEGO®, Universal, Illumination Entertainment, Hasbro®, Fox Digital Entertainment, Mattel®, Lamborghini®, and Ferrari®. Gameloft distributes its games in over 100 countries and employs 3,000 people worldwide. Every month, 55 million unique users can be reached by advertisers in Gameloft games with Gameloft for brands, a leading B2B offering dedicated to brands and agencies. Gameloft is a Vivendi company.

 **Job Description** **WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON**

**Main** **challenge**


We are looking for a Concept Artist to support the pre\-production and visual development of our core game titles, creating concepts and artistic references that help align production teams around a clear visual direction. The role focuses on projects inspired by the visual standards of Disney Speedstorm and Asphalt Legends.

**What it means** **on a daily basis**

* **Visual Concept Generation:** Create character designs and illustrations, including line art and 3D blockouts, in line with project requirements and the distinct visual styles of Hyperdrive, Asphalt, and Disney.
* **Creative Ideation:** Generate and develop artistic ideas while maintaining each game's unique visual identity.
* **Collaborative Design:** Collaborate with fellow artists and designers to develop and enhance the game's visual style.
* **Feedback Integration:** Work under the Studio Art Director's guidance, iterate on designs based on feedback, and deliver work in line with project goals and timelines.
* **Art Asset Planning:** Plan the creation of art assets for characters, environments, and props, and clearly communicate the approach and requirements to the relevant team members.

**What** **success will look like**


After 3 months, you will have built a strong understanding of the projects visual directions and production workflows. After 6 months, you will independently deliver concepts and references that support production decisions. You will also contribute consistently to the evolution of the games' visual identity and support effective collaboration across art and design teams.

**Who you would be working with**


You will report to the Studio Art Director and work closely with concept artists, artists, designers, and production teams. Your concepts and visual references will support local and international collaborators throughout the production process.

**Your recruitment** **journey**

* HR Screen Call: An initial conversation with our HR team.
* First Interview: A 20\-minute interview with the Hiring Manager to discuss your previous projects and experience.
* Test: You will have one week to complete a practical test.
* Second Interview: A discussion with the Hiring Manager to review your test, explore your approach in more detail, and share feedback.
* Final Interview: A meeting with the Studio Manager to discuss alignment and answer any remaining questions.

**Where this role can take you**


This role can offer opportunities to deepen your expertise in concept art, explore broader artistic responsibilities, and access development opportunities, mentorship, coaching, or internal mobility depending on business and individual opportunities

 **Qualifications** **WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED**

* Demonstrated advanced expertise in concept art or a related discipline, supported by a strong portfolio
* Advanced proficiency in Photoshop for digital art creation and proficiency with Blender or similar 3D software for concept development.
* Solid ability to produce clear and efficient sketches and develop concepts for characters, environments, and props.
* Ability to manage assigned work independently while collaborating closely with artists, designers, and production teams
* Fluent professional English, written and spoken, for collaboration in an international environment.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* You are comfortable developing ideas and adapting them based on feedback.
* You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with different team members.
* You can manage your work independently while contributing to a collaborative creative process.

 **WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU**

* Permanent contract, full\-time job with excellent Social Benefits.
* 25 vacation days per year
* Private medical health insurance
* Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card

**Benefits**

* Flexible work from home hybrid model
* Free language courses
* Birthday day off!
* 1 month of remote work
* Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
* Career\-development opportunities.
* Excellent local working conditions (quality of offices, geographical location of office in the centre of Barcelona).
* ... and Thursday afterwork beers!

 **Apply now !**
