title: Marketing Administration Executive
description:
**Company Description**

**About Entain**

There's nothing like a career at Entain. We're a leading, global sports betting and gaming company and we're upping the excitement and increasing player safety. We're a FTSE company with iconic brands including Ladbrokes, Coral, BetMGM, Eurobet and bwin, and we have an energy that drives us to perform at the height of our potential. Whether you're an engineer, marketer or retail specialist, a career here is a complete game changer.


**Job Description**

This is a **hybrid** role. As a **Marketing Administration Executive** , you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth day\-to\-day running of marketing operations across France, Spain and Portugal. Acting as the backbone of the regional marketing team, you will coordinate key administrative processes, manage budgets and supplier payments, support compliance requirements, and help ensure marketing activity is delivered efficiently and in line with internal processes.


Reporting to the **Head of Southwestern Europe** , you will be part of the **Southwestern Europe Marketing Team** , who are responsible for developing and delivering local marketing strategies and campaigns across France, Spain and Portugal. The team works closely with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders to drive growth, strengthen brand presence and deliver impactful customer experiences across multiple markets. This role plays a vital part in supporting the operational effectiveness of the team and ensuring marketing activity can be executed seamlessly.


This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast\-paced international marketing team, where you'll gain exposure to a broad range of marketing activities and collaborate with colleagues across multiple functions and markets. You'll have the chance to make a tangible impact by improving processes, supporting key stakeholders, and helping the team operate effectively. If you're highly organised, detail\-oriented and enjoy being at the centre of a busy, collaborative environment, **could this be the perfect next step for you?**

You Will:


* Coordinate the creation, tracking and renewal of marketing contracts, ensuring the correct approval processes are followed and records are maintained accurately.
* Raise and track purchase orders across France, Spain and Portugal, ensuring spend aligns with approved budgets and supplier requirements.
* Process and monitor marketing invoices, working closely with suppliers, Finance and internal stakeholders to resolve queries and support timely payments.
* Maintain budget trackers, reconciliations and reporting updates, providing marketing teams with accurate visibility of committed and actual spend.
* Support procurement and supplier onboarding activities by coordinating required information, following up approvals and keeping stakeholders informed.
* Coordinate marketing\-related compliance information requirements across France, Spain and Portugal, ensuring information is collected, organised and submitted on time.
* Organise and maintain marketing files, records and trackers, ensuring information is accurate, accessible and up to date.
* Provide day\-to\-day operational support to the regional marketing team, including meeting coordination, supplier follow\-up, document preparation and process management.
* Build strong working relationships with Marketing, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Compliance and external partners to ensure smooth and efficient delivery of marketing operations.

**Qualifications**

You Have:


* Works carefully and accurately, checking details before sharing information or moving a process forward.
* Plans work clearly, keeps trackers up to date and follows through on agreed actions.
* Collaborates well with colleagues across different markets and functions, adapting communication to the person and situation.
* Asks questions early when something is unclear and follows the right approval routes.
* Responds calmly to changing priorities and helps others understand what is needed to keep work moving.
* Looks for simple improvements that make recurring administration easier, clearer and more consistent.

**Additional Information**

**Benefits**

At Entain, we know that signing top players requires a great starting package, and plenty of support to inspire you. Join us, and a great compensation package is just the beginning. You can expect to receive benefits like:


* A regular bonus and great pension.
* €9\.60 food vouchers per day.
* 25 days annual leave
* Extra paid leave, including wellbeing and development days.
* Private healthcare and wellbeing support.
* A stake in our success through our ShareSave scheme.

**Equal Opportunities** .


If you need any **reasonable adjustments** at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us and we'll support you.


We're committed to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to be themselves.


We're an **equal opportunities employer** . We welcome applications from everyone and we do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender or gender reassignment, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marriage/civil partnership, or any other basis.


We comply with all applicable recruitment regulations and employment laws in the jurisdictions where we operate, ensuring ethical and compliant hiring practices globally.

* Excellent numerical and analytical skills.
* Effective communicator, both written and verbal with a structured and organised approach
* Excellent presentation skills and classroom delivery

* Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing priorities. Agility is key!

Even though we have requirements, our experience and background are just a guide, we still love to welcome applicants with more or less experience stated, provided necessary skills can be demonstrated.*

Are you ready to unlock your potential? At Straumann Group we’re on an exciting journey of growth, innovation, and impact \- driven by our mission to improve oral health and transform millions of lives worldwide. Working as a peer to Product Management Directors, you will orchestrate complex, multidisciplinary solutions across domains such as data acquisition, surgical, restorative, manufacturing and digital platforms. You will bring a holistic view across product domains and business units, helping teams align priorities, manage dependencies and evolve products as part of one coherent solution ecosystem.


This is a strategic role for someone who can combine portfolio thinking, customer insight, solution design and cross\-functional collaboration to shape how integrated solutions are delivered and adopted across the organization.

**Your Role**

**In this role you will:**

* Define and own the strategy for integrated, end\-to\-end solutions across the portfolio, ensuring alignment with business priorities, customer needs and portfolio goals.
* Translate customer needs, market opportunities and business priorities into clear solution strategies.
* Connect digital products, services, manufacturing capabilities and the implant portfolio into integrated customer solutions.

* Partner with commercial and customer\-facing teams to support adoption, implementation and value realization.
* Define and monitor measures for solution adoption, performance, customer value and business impact.
* Identify opportunities for innovation that emerge from integrating products, technologies, services and capabilities.

* Postgraduate degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Dentistry or a related field.

\#LI\-PA1


***TAG Heuer***
**MAISON**
--------------------------

1860, Saint\-Imier at the very heart of the birthplace of watchmaking. A young ambitious watchmaker decides to found his own brand. His name: Edouard Heuer. At just 20 years old, he was to revolutionize the watchmaking industry by breaking away from the established rules. Ever since that time, TAG Heuer’s vocation has been to push back the boundaries and defy convention to invent incredible watches and chronographs of extreme precision. The invention of the oscillating pinion in 1887 exemplified this spirit, streamlining the chronograph’s design and enhancing its responsiveness—a principle that underpins our engineering philosophy even today. Then came the 1916 Mikrograph, the first stopwatch accurate to 1/100th of a second, cementing TAG Heuer's reputation as the precision timekeeper in competitive sports. Capturing TAG Heuer’s ethos, our prominent partnerships and brand ambassadors express the brand’s passion for action and high performance. As for TAG Heuer ambassadors, they all share the ability to stand up to pressure, constantly pushing their limits. This illustrious group includes motorsport legends Ayrton Senna and Steve McQueen, Hollywood icons Ryan Gosling, Patrick Dempsey, Alexandra Daddario, and Wi Ha Jun, and tennis stars Naomi Osaka, Felix Auger\-Aliassime and Petra Kvitovà. * Partner retention and satisfaction rates
* Response time and quality of support
* Event participation and outcomes
* Documentation quality and timeliness
* Cross\-functional collaboration effectiveness

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

* Demonstrated experience in relationship management and business development
* Strong analytical and communication skills

description:

-------------------------



We are looking for an Associate Director, Capability Building \& Change Management to own and drive communication, change management, internal branding, asset creation, and capability\-building activities as part of Global Procurement Transformation. This role will shape how teams understand transformation priorities, adopt new tools and ways of working, engage with AI\-enabled and technology\-driven change, and build the capabilities needed in a more digital, data\-driven, and agile procurement environment.


The successful candidate will work closely with procurement leaders, subject matter experts, digital teams, global L\&D, technology partners, and external providers to lead clear communication, practical change adoption, targeted learning enablement, and compelling transformation storytelling. The role will bring structure, pace, and ownership to change activities, connect the right experts, align priorities, create reusable communication and enablement assets, and ensure Global Procurement Transformation changes are understood, supported, branded consistently, and embedded over time.

**Location**
------------



Croatia, Spain or the Netherlands

**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
-----------------------------


* **Own communication and stakeholder engagement for Global Procurement Transformation**
* Develop clear, audience\-relevant communication plans for Global Procurement Transformation priorities, initiatives, and activities.
* Translate complex business, process, and technology topics into simple messages that explain what is changing, why it matters, what support is available, and what actions are expected.
* Equip leaders and managers with messaging, materials, engagement moments, and communication assets that build understanding, confidence, and alignment.
* Develop communication assets, internal branding materials, launch narratives, leadership messages, FAQs, toolkits, and adoption content that create a consistent identity for procurement transformation and make change easier to understand and engage with.
* **Drive change management and adoption of new ways of working**
* Lead change readiness, stakeholder impact assessment, adoption planning, and reinforcement for procurement tools, processes, digital solutions, and AI\-enabled use cases where relevant.
* Support deployment of new procurement technologies and tools by shaping launch plans, adoption campaigns, readiness materials, and reinforcement activities that help users move from awareness to confident usage.
* Bring AI transformation into the change agenda by helping teams understand AI\-enabled use cases, responsible adoption expectations, capability needs, and practical examples of how AI can improve procurement work.
* Proactively identify adoption barriers, resistance, confusion, or capability gaps, and drive practical actions to address them.
* Partner with transformation, digital, process, and procurement teams to embed new ways of working into day\-to\-day routines and sustain momentum.
* Drive reinforcement activities that encourage sustained usage, behavior change, and measurable adoption over time.
* **Support procurement capability building and learning enablement**
* Build and maintain a practical procurement capability roadmap aligned with Global Procurement Transformation priorities, business needs, and future skills requirements.
* Help identify priority capability gaps across technical, digital, data, communication, change, and soft skills.
* Partner with procurement subject matter experts and global L\&D to translate specialist knowledge into practical learning, playbooks, communication assets, and adoption materials.
* Create practical enablement assets such as playbooks, one\-pagers, launch packs, quick reference guides, demo scripts, user communications, and adoption toolkits for new tools, AI\-enabled solutions, and transformation initiatives.
* Coordinate learning and enablement activities that build confidence, strengthen adoption, and improve team effectiveness.
* **Track progress and drive continuous improvement**
* Track simple, meaningful indicators for learning participation, adoption, capability uplift, and business impact where measurable.
* Use feedback, usage data, and stakeholder input to continuously improve learning content, adoption support, and the overall user experience.
* Partner with global L\&D operations to manage learning logistics, platform activities, and reporting with clear ownership and follow\-through.
**Your Skills and Experience**
------------------------------


* Master’s degree preferred; relevant certification in change management, learning and development, project/program management, or procurement is an advantage.
* 7\+ years of relevant experience in Procurement in a global corporate environment; experience with AI Transformations, supporting program communications, change management, procurement transformation, learning enablement, or functional capability programs is highly preferred
* Ability to create clear communication plans and support change readiness, impact assessment, adoption planning, reinforcement, and measurement for new ways of working.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to translate complex topics into clear, audience\-relevant messages.
* Comfort working with digital tools, AI\-enabled technologies, data, Microsoft Office applications, collaboration platforms, learning technologies, and communication asset creation tools.
**Also Good to Have**
---------------------


* Experience in program communications, change management, stakeholder engagement, capability building, or learning enablement within a global corporate or functional environment.
* Practical understanding of communication and change management activities, including readiness, stakeholder engagement, training, adoption, reinforcement, and measurement.
* Strong communication, storytelling, stakeholder engagement, and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and tailor messages for different audiences.
* A practical, delivery\-oriented mindset, with the ability to coordinate cross\-functional initiatives, manage change activities, and turn plans into clear actions.
* Comfort working with digital tools, AI\-enabled solutions, data\-driven ways of working, and technology\-enabled business transformation, including the ability to translate technology change into practical user adoption support.
* Ability to create engaging transformation assets and internal branding materials that make complex programs feel coherent, accessible, and easy to adopt across a global audience.
* Procurement, learning academy, digital adoption, change network, or learning platform experience would be an advantage.

This includes generous annual leave, reward plans, flexible working schedules (dependent on role), access to tailored health support, and meaningful ways to give back to the community. ESAC, Villanueva de la Cañada, Spain
  
  

Description
  
  

The European Space Agency maintains a world\-leading Science Programme with missions in heliophysics, planetary science, astrophysics and fundamental physics. Its mission is to empower Europe to lead space science.
  
  

The Science Operations Department (SCI\-S) within ESA’s Directorate of Science hosts the scientists and engineers that oversee the space missions from the study phase to the end of operations. It develops the science operation systems for the missions and operates the missions in space, as well as archiving and curating their data during operations and beyond. Its main objective is to maximise the scientific output of the missions for the benefit of humankind.
  
  

You will be assigned as Science Operations Scientist, initially for the Arrakihs mission under the direct responsibility of the Science Operations Development Manager for Arrakihs in the Science Operations Development Division.
  
  

Arrakihs is a “Fast” (F\-class) mission in ESA’s Science Programme. Its primary objective is to image the halos of galaxies in our nearby Universe to unprecedented low surface brightness, providing crucial data to answer unsolved questions in cosmology and galaxy evolution. Arrakihs is targeted for launch in the early 2030s.
  
  

Duties
  
  

You will be responsible for various aspects of the definition, implementation and testing of science operations activities for the Arrakihs mission, working in close collaboration with the Project Scientist, the Archive Scientist and the Science Operations Centre (SOC) Team and interfacing with the Instrument Operations and Science Data Centre (IOSDC) Team from the Arrakihs mission consortium.
  
  

During the development phase of the mission, your tasks and responsibilities will include:
  
  

acting as an interface between the Science Operations Centre, the Payload Team, the Flight Control Team and the Instrument Operations and Science Data Centre Team for the Arrakihs mission;
  
contributing to the overall ground segment operations definition, design and implementation;
  
coordinating and supporting the definition, development and testing of processes and tools for science mission planning activities;
  
providing support to the definition and validation of the instrument’s data products, as well as to the establishment of validation criteria and the development, implementation and testing of tools for their quality assessment in coordination with the Archive Scientist, the Project Scientist and the IOSDC Team;
  
acting as a product owner in the context of an Agile development strategy for the SOC system by providing the feedback, value and user acceptance testing for the various science operations functionalities;
  
supporting the Project Scientist and Science Operations Development Manager in analysing the impact of mission baseline changes, relating to operational rules and constraints, for example, on the scientific outcome of the mission;
  
supporting validation activities and all relevant compatibility, interfaces and end\-to\-end tests in preparation for the operation phase;
  
supporting the definition, preparation and execution of activities relating to the commissioning and science performance demonstration phases;
  
supporting the SOC interaction with the astronomical community in preparation for the Arrakihs filler programme, including the coordination of inputs and provision of relevant scientific and operational information;
  
supporting outreach activities promoting the Arrakihs mission and its science.
  
  

In addition to the above duties, you are expected to continue to carry out research and actively contribute to the scientific activities of the Department.
  
  

It is expected that the position will also involve support to other survey missions in development within the Division, for example the Ariel mission, which will study the atmosphere of exoplanets through spectroscopic observations during transits and eclipses.
  
  

Technical competencies
  
Experience in defining, setting up and/or operating scientific experiments for astrophysics research either in space or ground\-based facilities
  
Experience in coordinating internal/external stakeholders on scientific projects
  
Active researcher in a relevant field to the Arrakihs mission
  
Knowledge of scientific instruments performance and calibration specification and analysis
  
Behavioural competencies
  
  

Result Orientation
  
Operational Efficiency
  
Fostering Cooperation
  
Relationship Management
  
Continuous Improvement
  
Forward Thinking
  
  

Education and professional experience
  
  

A PhD in astronomy, physics or a related subject is required for this post, together with three years of relevant professional experience.
  
  

Additional requirements
  
  

International experience, i.e., outside your home country, as well as experience in diverse functional areas relevant to ESA activities.
  
  

**The following will be considered assets for the position:**  

* Experience in science operations of space\- or ground\-based facilities;
* Experience in analysing the science performance of instruments in space\- or ground\-based facilities;
* Experience with the Agile development methodology, preferably in the role of product owner;
* Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language, for example Python;
* Experience with media and outreach activities.


Diversity, Equity and Inclusiveness
  
ESA is an equal opportunity employer, committed to achieving diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. We therefore welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics.
  
  

At the Agency we value diversity, and we welcome people with disabilities. Whenever possible, we seek to accommodate individuals with disabilities by providing the necessary support at the workplace. The Human Resources Department can also provide assistance during the recruitment process. If you would like to discuss this further, please contact us via email at contact.human.resources@esa.int.
  
  

Important Information and Disclaimer
  
In principle, recruitment will be within the advertised grade band (A2\-A4\). However, if the selected candidate has less than four years of relevant professional experience following the completion of the master’s degree, the position may be filled at A1 level.

During the recruitment process, the Agency may request applicants to undergo selection tests. Additionally, successful candidates will need to undergo basic screening before appointment, which will be conducted by an external background screening service, in compliance with the European Space Agency's security procedures.

description:
**Tiered Approach**

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:


* **Tier 0** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026\.
* **Tier 1** : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments
* **Tier 2** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* **Tier 3 or no tier indicated** : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.  



**Background**

UNDP is the knowledge frontier organization for sustainable development in the UN Development System and serves as the integrator for collective action to realize the 2030 Agenda and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). UNDP’s policy work carried out at HQ, Regional and Country Office levels, forms a contiguous spectrum of deep local knowledge to cutting\-edge global perspectives and advocacy.


The Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS) has the responsibility for developing all relevant policy and guidance to support the results of UNDP’s Strategic Plan. BPPS’s staff provides technical advice to Country Offices; advocates for UNDP corporate messages, represents UNDP at multi\-stakeholder fora including public\-private dialogues, government and civil society dialogues, and engages in UN inter\-agency coordination in specific thematic areas. BPPS works closely with UNDP’s Crisis Bureau (CB) to support emergency and crisis response. BPPS ensures that issues of risk are fully integrated into UNDP’s development programmes. BPPS assists UNDP and partners to achieve higher quality development results through an integrated approach that links results\-based management and performance monitoring with more effective and new ways of working. BPPS supports UNDP and partners to be more innovative, knowledge and data driven including in its programme support efforts.


UNDP’s Strategic Plan 2026–2029 positions prosperity for all as one of four strategic objectives, alongside effective governance, crisis resilience and a healthy planet. The Strategic Plan frames UNDP’s contribution around integrated development solutions that support countries to advance human development in a fast\-changing world, powered by three accelerators: digital and AI transformation, gender equality and sustainable finance. Within this framework, prosperity is understood as more than income growth. It is linked to expanded opportunities, decent jobs and livelihoods, access to productive assets, human capital, social protection, essential services, protection from shocks, and the removal of structural barriers that prevent people from participating fully in economic and social life.


Within BPPS, the Prosperity and Wellbeing Hub advances UNDP’s integrated prosperity agenda by supporting countries to move from poverty to prosperity through expanded opportunities, enhanced capabilities, stronger systems, and more resilient development pathways. The Hub is organized around three mutually reinforcing pillars / service lines: 1\) Multi\-dimensional Poverty, Inequalities and Capabilities; (2\) Jobs, Growth, and Structural Transformation; and (3\) HIV, Health and Inclusion.


**Duties and Responsibilities**

Based in Madrid, the Head, Jobs, Growth and Transformation will lead the Hub’s second service line, providing senior\-level policy leadership, technical guidance and strategic positioning for UNDP’s work on jobs, livelihoods, inclusive growth and structural transformation. The Head will support the development and delivery of an integrated offer that helps countries translate economic transformation, private sector development and investment into concrete employment and livelihood outcomes.


This service line responds to increasing country demand for support on the systemic enablers of job\-rich development, including productivity growth, trade, industrial and sectoral policy, MSME competitiveness, value\-chain development, skills systems, local economic development, and transitions from informal to formal work. It will help countries identify and address barriers within labour markets and enterprise ecosystems, while supporting emerging opportunities associated with green, blue, digital and AI\-driven transitions, including jobs of the future. Across this work, particular attention will be given to women, young people, informal workers, MSMEs and groups facing structural barriers to economic participation.


The incumbent provides leadership, policy direction and strategic positioning for UNDP’s work on Jobs, Growth and Structural Transformation, and represents UNDP in the wider jobs, livelihoods and inclusive growth community of practice, including with the UN system, international financial institutions, bilateral partners, external experts, private sector actors, employers’ and workers’ organizations, and other relevant stakeholders.


The incumbent facilitates and coordinates implementation support to the Prosperity and Wellbeing Hub’s second service line. The incumbent ensures that UNDP’s offer on jobs, livelihoods and structural transformation is informed by country demand, experience from the ground, and broader policy debates and analytical advances on job\-rich growth, productive transformation, MSME development, skills, informality, trade, investment, green and digital transitions, and inclusive economic opportunity. To this end, the Head provides substantive leadership in the relevant technical areas and leverages capacities across the Hub, Regional Bureaux, Regional Hubs, Country Offices and the broader Global Policy Network.


UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to respond to evolving business needs and to harness synergies across interventions in pursuit of its strategic goals. This approach reflects the interconnected nature of development challenges, which require multidisciplinary teams and integrated, systemic responses. Therefore, the incumbent is expected to work across issues, units, functions, teams and projects — collaborating horizontally across the Prosperity and Wellbeing Hub and with other parts of UNDP, including governance, crisis, planet, gender, digital transformation and sustainable finance — to enhance coherence, quality and impact.


Under the guidance and direct supervision of the Director, Prosperity and Wellbeing, the Head is responsible for the following duties and responsibilities:


1\) Substantive leadership and quality assurance of policy advice on jobs, growth and structural transformation:


* Provide substantive leadership in the analysis of drivers, opportunities and constraints for job\-rich, inclusive and sustainable economic transformation, with a focus on employment, livelihoods, productivity, MSME development, skills, informality, trade, investment and structural transformation.
* Lead the development of relevant, timely and innovation\-focused knowledge products, policy analysis, tools and guidance on jobs, growth and structural transformation, in close collaboration with relevant teams across BPPS and the organization.
* Ensure that UNDP’s policy advice on jobs and livelihoods is informed by country experience, high\-quality quantitative and qualitative data, economic and labour market analysis, and the latest global policy debates and evidence.
* Develop and present cutting\-edge policy options to governments and other development actors on employment\-intensive growth, productive transformation, private sector development, enterprise ecosystems, skills systems, local economic development, and green, blue, digital and AI\-related transitions.
* Lead intersectoral policy dialogue on jobs, livelihoods and inclusive growth with governments, UN system partners, international financial institutions, donors, civil society, employers’ and workers’ organizations, academia and the private sector.
* Ensure quality assurance of policy and programme outputs related to the service line, including global, regional and country\-level initiatives.

2\) Provide high\-quality, timely and responsive technical and policy advice on prosperity and sustainable finance to Country Offices in the region:


* Provide substantive, timely, high\-quality and multidisciplinary policy and programme advisory services to Regional Bureaux, Regional Hubs and Country Offices in response to country demand, including through analysis, policy options, programme design, implementation support and quality assurance.
* Advice and support countries to design integrated approaches that connect national growth strategies, private sector development, investment, trade, skills and enterprise development with concrete employment and livelihood outcomes.
* Advise on labour market diagnostics, jobs strategies, MSME competitiveness, value\-chain development, informal\-to\-formal transitions, skills development, local economic development, and employment opportunities linked to green, blue, digital and AI\-driven transitions.
* Identify new areas of engagement and opportunities for innovation, scaling and portfolio development to position UNDP as a relevant actor in line with emerging country demand.
* Leverage internal and external expertise, including from the Economist Network, Regional Hubs, specialized technical teams, UN system partners, IFIs, academia and the private sector.
* Ensure coherence and alignment of jobs\-related policy and programme support with the broader work of the Prosperity and Wellbeing Hub and other BPPS teams, including on poverty, inequalities, capabilities, health, social protection, care systems, governance, crisis, planet, gender, digital transformation and sustainable finance.

3\) Coordinate and advise on the implementation of programme and policy objectives:


* Provide coordination and substantive support for the implementation of global programmes, initiatives and workstreams related to jobs, growth and structural transformation.
* Lead or support the development of global, regional and multi\-country offers, strategies, concept notes, project documents and resource mobilization proposals in areas under the service line.
* Support global processes, strategies and action plans in line with UNDP’s integrator function and its role in advancing the SDGs.
* Promote portfolio approaches that connect jobs and livelihoods with wider development objectives, including poverty reduction, inclusion, resilience, climate action, digital transformation, sustainable finance and local economic development.
* Support results\-based management, monitoring, reporting and learning for relevant initiatives, including the development of indicators and measurement approaches for employment, livelihoods and enterprise\-related outcomes.
* Contribute to internal planning, budgeting, reporting and performance management processes for the service line.

4\) Facilitate knowledge management, innovation, and community of practice networking:


* Set forth an operational platform for continuous data, analysis, documentation and codification of results and lessons learned on jobs, livelihoods and structural transformation for UNDP globally.
* Develop and deliver guidance material, tools, training and capacity development support for UNDP staff on jobs, livelihoods, inclusive growth and structural transformation.
* Promote the use of innovative approaches, data systems, digital tools, AI\-enabled analytics, foresight, systems thinking and portfolio methods to strengthen UNDP’s policy and programme support.
* Identify, document and disseminate promising practices from Country Offices and partners, including on employment\-intensive growth, MSMEs, skills, value chains, local economic development, informal\-to\-formal transitions and jobs of the future.
* Coordinate and strengthen communities of practice across Regional Bureaux, Regional Hubs and Country Offices.
* Build networks with academic and research institutions, think tanks, UN agencies, IFIs, bilateral partners and other expert organizations to enrich UNDP’s policy and programme offer.

5\) Representation, advocacy, and partner engagement for effective policy positioning:


* Represent UNDP in high\-profile areas, interagency coordination forums and external policy dialogues on jobs, livelihoods, inclusive growth and structural transformation.
* Advocate core UNDP messages and positions on job\-rich, inclusive and sustainable development, including the centrality of decent jobs and livelihoods to poverty\-to\-prosperity transitions.
* Promote South\-South and triangular cooperation by facilitating exchanges, peer learning and sharing of country experience where relevant.
* Foster strategic partnerships with UN system partners, IFIs, regional development banks, bilateral donors, foundations, civil society, academia, employers’ and workers’ organizations, and the private sector.
* Lead or contribute to resource mobilization efforts in line with BPPS priorities and corporate guidelines, including with traditional and emerging partners.
* Collaborate closely with BPPS teams, Regional Bureaux, the Economist Network, the Human Development Report Office, the Sustainable Finance Hub, the Digital Office and other relevant parts of UNDP to inform the strategic direction of UNDP’s policy advisory support.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization **.**

Supervisory/Managerial Responsibilities: Specialists, Analyst, as well as consultants or other personnel assigned to the Jobs, Growth and Structural Transformation service line.


**Competencies**

Core:


* Achieve Results: LEVEL 3: Set and align challenging, achievable objectives for multiple projects, have lasting impact.
* Think Innovatively: LEVEL 3: Proactively mitigate potential risks, develop new ideas to solve complex problems.
* Learn Continuously: LEVEL 3: Create and act on opportunities to expand horizons, diversify experiences.
* Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 3: Proactively initiate and champion change, manage multiple competing demands.
* Act with Determination: LEVEL 3: Think beyond immediate task/barriers and take action to achieve greater results.
* Engage and Partner: LEVEL 3: Political savvy, navigate complex landscape, champion inter\-agency collaboration.
* Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 3: Appreciate benefits of diverse workforce and champion inclusivity.

People Management:


UNDP People Management Competencies can be found in the dedicated site .


Cross Functional and Technical:

* Business Direction \& Strategy \- Systems Thinking: Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact on other parts of the system.
* Business Management \- Portfolio Management: Ability to select, prioritise and control the organization's programmes and projects in line with its strategic objectives and capacity. Ability to balance the implementation of change initiatives with regular activities for optimal return on investment. Knowledge and understanding of key principles of project, programme, and portfolio management.
* Business Management \- Working with Evidence and Data: Ability to inspect, cleanse, transform and model data with the goal of discovering useful information, informing conclusions and supporting decision\-making.
* 2030 Agenda: Prosperity \- Prosperity: Jobs, MSMEs, supply chains.

**Required Skills and Experience**

Education:


* Advanced university degree (master's degree or equivalent) in Economics, Development Economics, Statistics, Business/Public Administration, Public Finance, Finance, or related field is required. or
* A first\-level university degree (bachelor's degree or equivalent) in the areas stated above, in combination with an additional two years of qualifying experience will be given due consideration in lieu of the advanced university degree.

Experience:


* A minimum of 10 years (with master's degree) or 12 years (with bachelor's degree) of relevant experience in either public sector (national or multilateral, including UN), or private (academia, non\-governmental sector, corporate), with a demonstrated increasing level of responsibility in the relevant technical areas of jobs, livelihoods, inclusive growth, structural transformation, private sector development, MSME development, skills, labour markets, and/or economic advisory services is required.
* Demonstrated experience providing high\-level policy and programme advice on jobs, livelihoods, inclusive growth, labour markets, private sector development, MSME competitiveness, skills systems, local economic development, value\-chain development, and/or structural transformation is required.
* Experience in leading or supporting national development planning, employment strategies, growth diagnostics, labour market analysis, private sector development strategies, or sectoral/territorial development approaches, with demonstrated technical skills in policy analysis and partnership building with the World Bank, is required.
* Demonstrated experience in developing, quality assuring and applying tools, methodologies, diagnostics or policy options to support countries in designing and implementing strategies that link growth, productivity, investment and private sector development with employment and livelihood outcomes is required.
* Experience working on one or more of the following areas is required: informal\-to\-formal transitions; youth employment; women’s economic participation; MSME development; trade and value chains; skills for the future; green, blue, digital or AI\-related jobs and transitions; local economic development; or employment and livelihoods in crisis or transition contexts.
* Demonstrated experience leading and coordinating complex multidisciplinary policy or programme initiatives at scale, at global, regional and/or multi\-country level, related to jobs, inclusive growth, economic transformation, private sector development, labour markets or related areas, including providing strategic and technical direction, ensuring coherence across technical workstreams, and providing quality assurance and/or technical guidance across countries or regions is an asset.

description:
**At** **Lexroom** **we set the bar for legal AI—clear, fast, and built for trust.**


In just a few years, what began as an idea has become a reliable platform adopted by **thousands of legal professionals across Europe**.


Our mission is clear: **make the law faster, clearer, and more reliable**, giving lawyers, law firms, and companies the time and confidence to focus on what truly matters.


We’re scaling rapidly, backed by top\-tier investors and a world\-class team dedicated to rigor, clarity, and impact.


Today, Lexroom is a **trusted partner**, shaping the future of legal AI with discipline and purpose.

  

**Why** **Lexroom****?**
------------------------

* **Shape the Standard:** Be part of the team setting the benchmark for legal AI in Europe.
* **Work with the Best:** Collaborate with exceptional colleagues in a culture that values competence, curiosity, and ambition.
* **Deliver Meaningful Results:** Your contribution will directly influence how legal professionals work—faster, clearer, and more efficiently.


At **Lexroom**, we leave buzzwords behind. Here, you’ll build something that lasts: **a trusted platform, a strong reputation, a new standard for the legal world.**

  

**Role**
--------

**Lexroom** is building its partnership channel from close to zero and wants it to become a material driver of revenue growth. You will own that channel end to end: strategic reselling and co\-sell relationships with big consulting firms and system integrators, large enterprise accounts, and early\-stage product partnerships as our API surface develops. You will define the operating model, prove it in market, and build the team that scales it across our European footprint.


This is a build\-from\-scratch leadership seat reporting directly to our CRO and co\-founder, not a role inheriting an established motion.

**Your key responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* **Channel design and ownership**: design the partnership channel and build it into a material revenue driver, owning co\-sell and revenue\-share relationships end to end.
* **Operating model**: define whether and how partnership closes its own revenue versus feeds the sales pipeline, and build the case, grounded in data, for the model you back.
* **Relationship ownership**: personally run Lexroom's most valuable strategic relationships, from prospecting through signature.
* **Playbook design**: build repeatable processes for partner sourcing, qualification, engagement rules, and co\-sell motion from the ground up.
* **Team building**: hire and lead country partnership leads and associates as deal volume justifies.
* **Partner enablement and certification**: build training, certification, and co\-marketing materials that let partners sell and implement independently over time.
* **Tooling and attribution**: define the partner\-source model in the CRM, own the deal registration policy, and track partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced pipeline with the discipline of a revenue function, not a marketing one.
* **Performance management and partner reviews**: define KPIs (pipeline generated, ARR sourced or influenced, logos activated), build dashboards, and run structured quarterly business reviews with strategic partners.
* **Cross\-functional alignment**: agree lead handoff and attribution rules with Sales leaders, work with Finance and Legal on commission and revenue\-share structures, and scope product\-partnership opportunities with Product.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* **Partnership leadership track record**: 7\+ years in business development, alliances, or channel roles in B2B SaaS, including at least 3 years owning revenue\-accountable relationships with system integrators or consulting partners in an enterprise or mid\-market context. Ideally you have built a partnership motion from an early stage rather than inherited one at scale.
* **Complex deal negotiation**: the commercial rigour to structure and close revenue\-share and co\-sell agreements with Big 4 firms and system integrators, including multi\-stakeholder, long\-cycle negotiations. Familiarity with frameworks such as MEDDICC or Challenger Sale is a plus.
* **Builder mindset, not a maintainer**: comfortable building playbooks, attribution models, and team rituals from scratch in a function where most of the infrastructure does not exist yet.
* **International experience**: you have built or managed partnership relationships across multiple European markets. You know a playbook that works in one country rarely transfers unchanged, and you adjust commercial terms and positioning accordingly.
* **Commercial and analytical judgment**: able to structure and negotiate commission and revenue\-share terms, build pipeline and ARR forecasting for partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced deals, and make prioritisation calls on which partners and deals to pursue, grounded in data.
* **Languages**: fluent English is required, plus professional fluency in at least one of Italian, French, Spanish, or German. Additional European languages are a plus.

**Rewarding your contribution**
-------------------------------

* **Compensation (Milan equivalent)**: €120,000–160,000 OTE
* **Equity**: meaningful equity on top, in line with the seniority of the role
* **Team retreats \& off\-sites**: dedicated time to connect, collaborate, and spark bold ideas

 **At Lexroom, ambition meets discipline and purpose.**


We're not just building a product—we're setting a new standard for the legal world. If you're ready to contribute to something lasting and meaningful, we'd love to hear from you.


Compensation Range: €120K \- €160K

Spain is a strategic market for Combo. We already have an established local Sales team and a growing customer base. Our next challenge is to continue structuring our Customer Success approach while ensuring our Spanish customers get the support and experience they need to succeed with Combo.


This is a highly hands\-on and operational role.


You won't simply manage a portfolio of customers. You'll take ownership of their overall experience: from supporting key accounts to handling day\-to\-day requests, while also building scalable processes that will allow us to grow.

**More than 150,000 employees use Combo every day.**
----------------------------------------------------


To check their schedules. Track their hours. Manage their teams.


At Combo, we build HR solutions for companies with deskless teams: restaurants, hotels, retailers, pharmacies, bakeries, sports and leisure businesses, and more.


The adventure started in 2016 with a simple idea: making HR easier for businesses and the people who run them.


Today, thousands of companies across Europe rely on Combo to simplify their day\-to\-day HR operations.


Our platform brings together the tools teams need every day: scheduling, contract management, payroll preparation, team communication, and productivity tracking.


And we're still growing.

**Your role**
-------------


You'll be the main point of contact and advocate for our Spanish customers.


Your mission is simple: help them get the most out of Combo while building a Customer Success approach that can scale with our business.


The role combines **Account Management, Customer Success, Customer Care, and continuous improvement**.

### **You'll support our customers every day**


You'll build strong and trusted relationships with our key accounts and help them get the most value from Combo.


You'll also handle more operational requests from customers with speed, empathy, and pragmatism.


You'll become a key point of contact for our Spanish customers and make sure every interaction with Combo leads to a clear and useful outcome.

### **You'll build processes that can scale**


Not every customer needs the same level of support.


For our key accounts, you'll provide a more personalised and proactive approach.


For the rest of our customer base, you'll design and implement scalable ways to provide value: webinars, communication campaigns, automated sequences, content, Help Center articles, and more.


The goal? Deliver the right level of support at the right time, without relying exclusively on manual interactions.


You'll identify friction points throughout the customer journey and find practical ways to simplify and automate recurring interactions.

### **You'll keep a close eye on customer health**


You'll maintain a clear understanding of your customer base.


Product usage, engagement, satisfaction, churn risks: you'll know where to look and how to interpret the signals.


You'll identify potential risks early and implement concrete action plans to prevent churn.


Data quality is essential in this role. Your CRM will be reliable, your customer information up to date, and your tracking rigorous enough to give the wider team a clear view of what's happening.

### **You'll bring the voice of the Spanish market to Combo**


You'll be close to our Spanish customers.


Their feedback, frustrations, and needs will be valuable insights for the rest of Combo.


You'll structure this feedback and turn it into clear, actionable insights for our Product and Operations teams.


Your role won't simply be to forward customer requests.


You'll help us understand what's really happening on the ground and what our Spanish customers need.

**This role is made for you if...**
-----------------------------------


You have at least **2 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Customer Support**, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.


You've already worked with customers requiring different levels of support and are comfortable combining **High Touch and scalable, Low Touch approaches**.


You're a natural problem solver.


When something isn't working perfectly, your first instinct is to understand the situation and find a practical solution.


You don't need every process to already exist before moving forward. You're comfortable structuring, testing, and building things.


You're autonomous, organised, and comfortable in a fast\-paced environment.


You care about the quality of your work, especially when it comes to customer follow\-up and data. For you, keeping a clean and reliable CRM isn't just a detail.


You're also comfortable with numbers and able to understand topics related to HR or payroll.


And most importantly:


**You're a native or fully fluent Spanish speaker**, both written and spoken.


**You're fluent in English**, as you'll work daily with your manager and international teams.


French is a strong plus, but not a requirement.

**Why join Combo?**
-------------------


Because you won't be joining a Customer Success organisation where everything has already been figured out.


You'll have a customer base to support, but also plenty of things to build.


You'll have a real impact on how we support our Spanish customers: improving processes, structuring data, creating playbooks, and testing new approaches.


You'll work closely with our Spanish Sales team while also being part of an international Customer Success organisation.


This is a role for someone who enjoys autonomy, thrives in fast\-moving environments, and gets just as much satisfaction from solving a customer problem as from building a process that prevents it from happening again.

**What we offer**
-----------------


**A gross annual fixed salary between €34K and €41K**, depending on your experience.


And also:

* **Stock options** once your probation period has been successfully completed
* ️ **Meal vouchers**
* **A 40\-hour working week**
* A role based in our **Madrid office**
* An international environment, working closely with teams in France
* A high\-impact role with real ownership over a strategic market and customer base
* ️ The opportunity to build, structure, and improve the way we support our customers in Spain
* A close\-knit local Sales team, backed by an established and growing European scale\-up
* Plenty of autonomy and room to make an impact

**Our hiring process**
----------------------

**Step 1 – HR Screening (30 min)**


A first conversation with **Thomas, Talent Acquisition Manager**, to get to know each other, tell you more about Combo, and discuss your experience and expectations.

**Step 2 – Management Fit (60 min)**


A conversation with **Estelle, Head of Customer Success**, to discuss the role in more detail, your experience, and how you approach Customer Success and customer management.

**Step 3 – Skill Test**


A practical exercise designed to better understand how you approach real\-life situations you could face in the role.

**Step 4 – Culture Fit**


A final meeting at our **Madrid office**, where you'll get to meet the team and learn more about how we work at Combo.

**Our commitment**
------------------


At Combo, we believe diverse teams make better decisions, build better products, and create stronger companies.


We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and grow.

This role holds user experience design and architecture accountability for Medical Affairs' AI\-powered platforms and digital products. It owns the design of workflows and interfaces for all products and ensures they are adopted. This role drives how AI agents behave, where human judgment must remain in the loop, and defines end\-to\-end workflows. This role is accountable for facilitating discovery workshops, designing interfaces, and conducting usability testing directly with users.


The role operates within a tightly coupled technical pod, working directly under Architecture leadership and in continuous partnership with Engineering and Product Owner leads, while also serving as the senior experience voice in front of Medical Affairs business stakeholders— arbitrating design trade\-offs and building the trust needed to transform business process workflows.


Serve as AI Experience and Workflow Design Lead within Medical AI Acceleration and Delivery organization, reporting to Architecture Lead. This role owns experience architecture end\-to\-end for Medical Affairs' AI\-powered platforms and digital products, defining the future\-state workflows, and AI\-first operating models that deliver measurable business and colleague outcomes at enterprise scale. This role leads by influence across Medical Affairs, product, and engineering, — designing user experiences and leveraging AI tools and agents to accelerate delivery. The AI Experience and Workflow Design lead frames complex transformation problems, arbitrates competing design decisions, and is accountable for whether AI\-enabled workflows earn trust and adoption in production.

**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the definition of future\-state AI\-enabled workflows, identifying where AI assistants remove manual effort, accelerate decisions, and improve end\-to\-end experiences.

title: Senior Manager, CX Messaging and Activation Lead
description:
At Pfizer, our purpose is breakthroughs that change patients' lives. As we implement our AI Transformation, our GTM and Adoption team helps turn digital investment into real impact by understanding and removing barriers, driving high\-impact engagement, and ensuring the new digital platforms we launch become embedded into how our colleagues work.
   

  

 This is a product marketing role. The products are internal AI platforms. The market is roughly 80,000 Pfizer colleagues around the world. Positioning, segmentation, launch, and demand generation all apply here, with adoption and retention as the scoreboard.
   

  

 The craft at the center of the role is positioning: holding one argument per platform and telling it in many ways. A scientist in the lab, a supervisor on a manufacturing line, and an analyst in finance should each recognize their own work in the same value proposition, and a colleague who has never heard of a platform needs something different from one who tried it once and stopped. Working norms, language, and attitudes toward AI at work also differ across our markets and business lines, so messaging here is adapted for the audience rather than translated once and sent everywhere. What we are claiming stays constant. How it is told, to whom, and at what point in their journey is where this role does its work.
   

  

 This role translates technical features into highly compelling, user\-centric narratives, running internal product launches with the same rigor, creativity, and brand building typically reserved for external consumer technology launches. Most internal launch emails and mandatory announcements get ignored, and that's the bar this role is here to clear: before defaulting to the standard internal\-comms playbook, this role tries something unconventional first, and builds campaigns around what actually earns attention rather than what's easiest to schedule.
   

  

**Positioning, Messaging \& Segmentation**
* Segment by lifecycle stage rather than by org chart. Match messaging to where a colleague sits with a platform: one who has never heard of it needs a reason to care, one who tried it once and stopped needs a different reason to come back, and one who uses it weekly needs to know what changed.
* Build divisional and cultural understanding into the work. Language, regulatory context, working norms, and attitudes toward AI at work differ across markets and business lines, and a message that reads as exciting in one place can read as overselling or as a threat in another. Partner with divisional and local communicators so messaging is adapted rather than translated.
* Ground the WIIFM ("What’s In It For Me") in the colleague’s actual workday: the task that gets shorter, the handoff that stops breaking, the report nobody has to rebuild by hand. Avoid capability claims that do not name a job somebody is trying to get done.
* Own the competitive frame. Position each platform against what colleagues are choosing instead, whether an external consumer AI tool, a manual workaround, or doing nothing, and make the honest case for the internal option rather than assuming the audience is captive.
* Test messaging with real colleagues before it ships, in more than one division, and rewrite what does not land.
* Keep the message library current as platforms change, and retire claims that stop being true.


**Go\-to\-Market \& Launch**
* Set the channel and audience strategy for each launch, deciding which channels to use and who to target, and own the resulting content end to end, creative through send.
* Coordinate channel and audience decisions with the Peer Advocacy \& Community Lead so broadcast and community messaging reinforce each other rather than duplicate or conflict.
* Write the go\-to\-market plan for every major launch: target audience, messaging pillars in play, channel mix, sequencing, asset list, dates, and the adoption number the launch is meant to move. A launch is a plan on paper before it is a calendar invite.
* Run the pre\-launch phase. Early access cohorts, waitlists, teasers, and champion previews build demand ahead of general availability so day one has an audience waiting rather than an audience being informed.
* Sequence the launch with the CX Training Lead and the Peer Advocacy \& Community Lead so messaging, training readiness, and community activity land in the right order rather than competing on the same day.
* Run a post\-launch review after every Major launch: what the campaign moved, what it did not, and what changes in the next one. Feed the pattern back into the reusable launch approach.


**Demand Generation \& Funnel Ownership**
* Own the top of the funnel end to end, from unaware through interested to first use. Know the drop\-off at each step, and fix the weakest step rather than adding more volume at the top.
* Build the always\-on layer that runs between launches so demand does not depend on a campaign being live: placement on the surfaces colleagues already hit, internal search and intranet presence, the platform site, and the moments new joiners are most open to trying something.


**Enablement, Standards \& Message Governance**
* Establish the reusable launch playbook: message standards, frameworks, and templates that later launches and other teams run on.
* Enable the people who carry the message. Equip stakeholders, champions, and divisional communicators with the positioning, proof points, and assets to make the case in their own words. This is sales enablement without a sales team.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing through communication channels that connect colleagues with successful practices, lessons learned, and success stories.
* Prepare colleagues for change by developing communication strategies that support adoption of new tools, workflows, and behaviors.


**Platform \& Strategy Partnership**
* Partner closely with the Experience Architecture and Product teams to understand what each platform is and the CX strategy defined for it, so positioning and messaging stay grounded in the platform’s actual intent.
* Feed user insights, friction points, and feature requests surfaced through campaigns and interviews back to the teams building and evolving each platform.


**Ethical Use \& Responsible AI Messaging**
* Define clear, plain\-language guidance on the ethical and responsible use of each AI platform, appropriate use cases, data handling, and when to trust versus verify AI output, as part of launch and ongoing messaging.
* Shape that guidance in partnership with Legal, Compliance, and Regulatory Affairs so it stays accurate and consistent as platforms evolve.
* Share ethical\-use guidance directly with the CX Training Lead so it gets built into training content, and with the Peer Advocacy \& Community Lead so it is reinforced through the champion network and community norms.


**Legal \& Regulatory Alignment**
* Own the legal, compliance, and regulatory review checkpoint for platform messaging, built into the launch timeline as a fast, repeatable step rather than a one\-off cycle, so nothing overstates a platform’s capabilities, data handling, or compliance posture.
* Know which platforms touch regulated, clinical, or personal data, and keep messaging current with internal policy on AI\-related communications.


**Producing the Work, Not Just Briefing It**
* Write, design, and produce the core campaign assets, launch copy, short\-form video, key visuals, on a real production cadence.
* This is not a brief\-an\-agency\-and\-wait role; the person hired is expected to make the work themselves or partner internally with the design teams, especially in the early days of a launch when speed matters most.


**Campaign Metrics Tied to Real Adoption**
* Set quarterly targets for campaign metrics (click\-throughs, video views, waitlist sign\-ups), but treat none of them as the finish line.
* Ensure every campaign metric ladders up to the platform’s two core success metrics, 30\-day active use and the Sean Ellis test.
* Partner with the Adoption Analytics \& Insights Lead on the dashboard that shows that connection, not just the vanity numbers.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field.
* 6–8\+ years in product marketing, digital marketing, or brand strategy, with a highly creative portfolio. Product marketing for a software, SaaS, or platform product is the closest fit, whether the audience was external customers or internal users.
* Experience owning top\-of\-funnel performance, including awareness\-to\-first\-use conversion and diagnosing where an audience drops off.
* Experience owning a product launch end to end, including go\-to\-market planning, launch tiering, pre\-launch demand building, and post\-launch review.
* Experience building a messaging architecture (pillars, proof points, persona\-level messaging) for a product or platform and holding other teams to it.
* Experience establishing messaging standards, launch frameworks, or reusable practices that other teams, platforms, or business units adopt.
* Experience translating complex technical or AI capabilities into clear, persona\-specific business benefits and messaging.
* Hands\-on experience personally writing, designing, and producing campaign assets on areal production cadence, not only briefing and reviewing agency or vendor work.
* Experience defining launch tiers and orchestrating cross\-functional launch timelines and communications.
* Daily, hands\-on use of AI tools in your own production work, with a clear view of where they help and where they fall short.
* Experience partnering with Legal, Compliance, or Regulatory teams to review communications before publication, ideally within a pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other regulated industry.
* Comfort tying campaign metrics (engagement, click\-through, sign\-ups) to downstream adoption and retention outcomes rather than treating them as the end goal.

* Proficiency with modern creative design and video editing tools.

description:
#### **This is Edenspiekermann**


We are Edenspiekermann, an independent design consultancy with 40\+ years of experience helping world\-leading organizations invent, build, and evolve their products.


Our interaction designers work in agile and interdisciplinary teams on websites and platforms for major brands as well as for startups. Our teams combine conceptual thinking, a sophisticated understanding of design and a deep knowledge of web and app development to develop a digital product or service with a user\-centric approach. In doing so, we advise and coach our clients' teams to provide the best customer experience for their customers.

#### **Description**


We are looking for a hands\-on Design Director to join our US team in a permanent, remote\-first role based in Southern California. You will work primarily from home and be available to travel to client sites across the United States as engagements require. You will lead complex digital\-product and design\-system engagements across our portfolio, including work in regulated industries and global medical technology. AI will be a core part of how you explore, prototype, make decisions, and help teams deliver better work.  

This is a senior client\-facing role for someone who is excited by how AI is changing design and product development. You will set direction, stay close to the work, and help clients move from isolated experiments to useful AI\-enabled products, workflows, and operating models. You will combine curiosity and speed with strong judgment about where human craft, review, and accountability matter.

#### **Your Tasks**

* Lead client engagements end\-to\-end, from initial framing and design direction through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Translate user needs, business goals, brand intent, accessibility, engineering, content, and compliance requirements into clear product and system direction.
* Own the design quality of the work, balancing strategic clarity with strong visual, interaction, and systems\-design craft.
* Direct the creation and evolution of scalable Figma libraries, component architectures, variables, tokens, themes, patterns, prototypes, and documentation.
* Work closely with product and engineering leaders to connect design decisions with production code, release processes, and measurable product outcomes.
* Establish practical governance and contribution models that support distributed teams without overloading a small central group.
* Facilitate workshops and decision\-making with senior stakeholders across design, product, engineering, research, content, and compliance.
* Guide multidisciplinary teams, coach designers, set a high bar for craft, and give clear, constructive direction.
* Make AI part of the design practice every day, using it for research synthesis, ideation, content, prototyping, design\-system work, and design\-to\-code exploration.
* Prototype AI\-enabled product experiences, including conversational, adaptive, generative, and agentic interactions, then test whether they create meaningful value for people.
* Experiment quickly with new tools and models, share what works, and help the team build repeatable AI workflows instead of one\-off demos.
* Evaluate AI output critically and establish practical guardrails for quality, accessibility, privacy, approved source material, human review, and accountability.
* Help shape Edenspiekermann's AI\-enabled product and design\-systems practice, contributing to how we pitch, deliver, and talk about the work.
#### **Your profile**

* You have at least 8 years of experience in product design, UX/UI design, or design systems, including several years leading complex client or enterprise engagements.
* Your portfolio demonstrates systems thinking, refined visual craft, shipped digital products, and credible AI\-enabled work.
* You have led design systems across multiple products, platforms, brands, or teams and understand how they connect to Figma libraries, production code, documentation, versioning, and engineering adoption.
* You have experience in a regulated or high\-accountability environment and treat accessibility as a system requirement.
* You can lead senior client conversations, facilitate difficult decisions, and turn ambiguity into a practical path forward with curiosity, judgment, and a collaborative, low\-ego attitude.
* You actively use generative and agentic AI in your own practice, can demonstrate workflows beyond surface\-level prompting, and can separate useful applications from hype.
* You communicate fluently in English and are comfortable collaborating across US and European teams.
* You are based in Southern California, willing and able to travel to client sites across the United States as engagements require, and legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
#### **We Offer**

* A permanent, full\-time, remote\-first role with a central place in our US design team.
* The annual salary range for this position is $120,000 to $150,000, depending on experience and qualifications.
* A defined contribution toward medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus access to a healthcare FSA.
* A 401(k) plan with a 2% company match and eligibility for a discretionary year\-end bonus based on company performance.
* A flexible PTO policy, with time off coordinated around client and team commitments, plus eleven paid holidays, a year\-end office closure, monthly internet and wellness stipends, and professional\-development support.
* The opportunity to lead visible, strategically important product, design\-system, and AI\-enabled transformation engagements.
* An international portfolio and regular collaboration with colleagues across Europe and the United States.
* A high\-craft, low\-ego team with direct access to partners and senior leadership, real autonomy, constructive feedback, and space to shape how we work.
* A multidisciplinary team that is actively building AI into design, strategy, research, engineering, and delivery.
#### **We are pleased to meet you!**


We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications – regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/beliefs, disability, age, and sexual orientation and identity.

**If you are interested, please provide us with the following documents and information:**

* Current CV
* Portfolio with at least one substantial product or design\-system case and a credible AI\-enabled product or workflow example
* A short explanation of your role, decisions, measurable contribution, and how AI changed the work or outcome
* Earliest possible start date


One more thing, never fear to apply initiative. We understand: a lack of confidence can sometimes keep us from applying for a job. But guess what?! There is no such thing as the perfect applicant. That's why we encourage you to apply to us.
