**Role:** 
 Communications Manager
 



**Location:** 
 Mexico City, Mexico (remote, with weekly in\-person syncs)
 



**Working pattern:** 
 EST overlap required
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Head of Marketing
 



  





**ABOUT COSIGN** 




  






 Cosign is the fastest growing prop\-tech company in the United States revolutionizing the $4 trillion rental industry with a market\-leading one\-of\-a\-kind rent guarantee product. Our mission is to expand housing access for renters and boost occupancy for landlords. Backed by top entrepreneurs, venture capital firms, and real estate investors, Cosign is built by experienced landlords and managers for landlords and managers who deeply understand the rental market's needs.
 



  





**OUR MISSION CONTINUED** 




  





 Cosign is on a mission to expand access to housing by helping landlords approve more qualified renters without increasing risk. We partner with owners and property managers to close the qualification gap caused by conditional approvals, thin credit files, and the absence of guarantors, materially improving leasing conversion and occupancy. We're building toward a near future where every U.S. property offers Cosign to renters who struggle to qualify, expanding housing choice while helping owners and operators convert demand into signed leases.
 



  





**OUR HIRING PHILOSOPHY** 




  





 At Cosign, we seek exceptional talent with relentless intellectual curiosity, individuals who:
 



  




* Challenge the status quo and drive continuous improvement
* Demand excellence from themselves and their colleagues
* Identify and solve problems others don't even recognize
* Create innovative solutions others believe impossible



  





 We deliberately seek these rare, high\-impact performers who attract similar talent. While most companies avoid hiring these exceptional individuals due to their demanding nature, we actively pursue them. When we find someone extraordinary, we move quickly to bring them onboard.
 



  





 We believe average talent builds average companies. By assembling a team of exceptional performers, we're creating the talent density needed to transform the rental industry and set new standards of excellence.
 



  





**THE OPPORTUNITY** 




  





 Calling all storytellers and brand builders. We're looking for a strategic, hands\-on Communications Manager who can own how Cosign shows up everywhere, externally and internally, from leadership's LinkedIn to the sales deck in a rep's hand. You will build the communications function from the ground up and define how Cosign sounds at every touchpoint.
 



  





 As our first
 
 Communications Manager
 
 , you will own the entire stack: owned\-channel strategy across LinkedIn, blog, website, PR, and executive communications, plus the messaging frameworks, sales collateral, and enablement materials that arm Sales, Partnerships, and Customer Success to sell with confidence. You will build the content engine behind our executive thought leadership and our Partnerships team's outreach, while partnering closely with leadership to keep every customer\-facing message clear, consistent, and on\-position.
 



  





 Reporting to the Head of Marketing, this is a player\-coach role: you'll ship high\-stakes content yourself while coaching and upskilling a Copywriter, raising the bar for every piece of writing that leaves the company. It is ideal for someone who thrives in a startup environment, has built a communications function from 0 to 1 before, and is excited to own the full narrative, inside and outside the company, in a fast\-moving, early\-stage context.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Own Cosign's external communications engine across LinkedIn, the website, blog, PR, executive communications, and every customer\-facing channel, ensuring a consistent, compelling brand voice at every touchpoint
* Own the communications strategy end\-to\-end: editorial direction, messaging frameworks, brand voice, content planning, and cross\-functional alignment across Marketing, Product, Sales, and Customer Success
* Build executive thought leadership that positions Cosign as an industry leader: managing leadership's LinkedIn presence, executive content, presentations, speeches, interviews, and other public\-facing communications
* Drive the content and SEO strategy that builds awareness and authority: owning website messaging, blog content, organic growth, and continuously improving search performance in partnership with our design lead
* Lead PR, strategic communications, and high\-impact initiatives: partnering with the Head of Marketing on media opportunities, AI\-driven marketing initiatives, product launches, and company\-wide communications projects
* Own sales enablement and internal messaging from strategy to execution: creating and maintaining presentations, one\-pagers, case studies, battlecards, sales templates, launch communications, FAQs, webinars, and messaging documentation, ensuring every team tells a consistent story to prospects, customers, partners, and investors
* Coach and develop our Copywriter as a player\-coach: setting the quality bar, giving structured feedback, and upskilling them on voice, AI\-assisted workflows, and editorial judgment



  





**ABOUT YOU** 




  





 As a highly motivated and data\-driven communications expert, you take full ownership of the communications function, from messaging strategy to final content execution, without needing direction. You are deeply committed to your targets, remain structured under pressure, and distinguish true impact from mere output.
 



  





 You thrive in early\-stage landscapes where processes are still evolving. Instead of seeing gaps as obstacles, you view them as chances to innovate, bring fresh ideas, and find energy in constructing something new rather than simply working inside it.
 



  





 You are a storyteller at heart, comfortable adapting your voice across executives, customers, partners, media, and internal teams, and using SEO insights and AI to drive the highest\-performing content.
 



  





**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE** 




  





 We are looking for a passionate communications leader who is excited to shape Cosign's voice and build a world\-class communications function from the ground up.
 



  




* 3\-5\+ years of experience in Communications, Content Marketing, Corporate Communications, Editorial, Brand Marketing, or a related field, ideally within a startup environment
* Exceptional writing and editing skills, with experience creating content for executives, customers, sales teams, partners, and media while maintaining a consistent brand voice
* Proven experience building executive thought leadership, particularly on LinkedIn, and growing organic brand presence through strategic content
* Hands\-on ownership of website content, company blogs, editorial calendars, and SEO\-driven content strategies using tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Google Search Console
* Strong AI fluency, leveraging tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms to accelerate research, content creation, and editing workflows
* Experience creating sales enablement materials, including presentations, one\-pagers, case studies, battlecards, and messaging frameworks, that support revenue teams throughout the customer journey
* Excellent project management skills, with experience coordinating multiple stakeholders and managing editorial workflows using tools like Notion, Asana, or similar platforms
* Strong cross\-functional leadership and the ability to influence Product, Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, and executive stakeholders without formal authority
* A passion for building systems from scratch, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment



  





**WHAT MAKES THIS OPPORTUNITY DIFFERENT** 




  





 This is an opportunity to join one of the fastest\-growing companies in U.S. PropTech at a pivotal moment in our growth. You will shape how Cosign communicates with the world, building the voice, content engine, and communications strategy that define our brand across customers, partners, investors, and the broader industry.
 



  





 You will work alongside a team of exceptional performers, partner directly with senior leadership, and have real ownership over strategy and execution from day one. From building executive thought leadership and scaling our content engine to shaping company messaging and sales enablement, your work will have a direct impact on our growth and market presence.
 



  





**WORKING AT COSIGN** 




  





 This is a remote role, with our Marketing team centered around Mexico City. We believe great work happens through both flexibility and connection, so you'll have regular opportunities to collaborate with teammates in person through weekly meetups and team gatherings.
 



  





 Cosign is looking for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment and is excited to build alongside an ambitious team. We'll give you the autonomy to make an impact, the support to grow, and the opportunity to help shape both our communications function and the future of housing.

description:

 Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
   

  

 Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Where and how you can work**
 Our headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. Since we don’t have a physical campus in Argentina, this role is fully remote—giving you the flexibility to do your best work from wherever you thrive.
   

  

**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**
 As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.
   

  

**At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On**
* Strategy. Act as the main leadership point of contact with responsibility for overall user and revenue growth in Argentina. You'll bring together local and global teams across marketing, sales, product, content and finance to create and execute a cohesive multi\-year growth strategy, and own the KPIs including MAUs and ARR.
* Localisation. Work closely with the regional team to optimise our product, content, pricing and packaging to meet the needs of local users, informed by a deep understanding of local market dynamics and cultural nuances across a range of audiences, including knowledge workers, SMBs, students, startup ecosystems, NGOs, and other emerging sectors.
* Leadership. Hire, inspire, drive and in some cases coach the in\-market team, ensuring a high quality bar for impact and working closely with local speciality leads on performance management.
* Budget. Partner closely with the regional team and marketing lead to shape the marketing strategy and deployment of budget.
* Sponsorship. Build and support high value relationships by acting as a local sponsor for enterprise sales, education, government, partnerships, etc.
* Public face. Represent Canva as a local figurehead across press, PR, events and community.


**You're probably a match if**
* You are strongly entrepreneurial. Founder\-style appetite for growing something big from a small start and working across everything from education to press.
* You possess experience growing a market. For example, as the regional GM or brand lead for a global SaaS company, or as a proven founder or growth lead in a startup in a high growth environment.
* You are a proven leader. Ability to grow, inspire, and coach high\-performing teams. You have high emotional intelligence and empathy, and are a deeply collaborative teammate.
* You are a strong communicator. Fully proficient in spoken and written English, and with the interpersonal skills to influence global and local stakeholders.
* You are keenly analytical. Deeply focused on KPIs and obsessive about driving actionable insights from disparate datasets and able to think about a market’s performance holistically.
* you are product oriented. Passion for improving the experience of users and the ability to translate local insights into product requirements with experience localising a global product for a particular market.
* You are values aligned. Genuinely excited by Canva’s mission and deeply aligned with our values, and with exceptional references to prove it.
* You are publicity savvy. Experience doing public speaking and acting as a public face to the press and other stakeholders.
* You are well networked. Ideally with routes into some combination of government departments, corporates, influencers, journalists and local talent


**About The Team**
 Canva’s International supergroup is a diverse, distributed team of marketers, strategists, and growth leaders focused on expanding Canva's presence in key global markets. Our team partners with functions across Marketing, Growth, Product, Sales, Partnerships, Content, Finance, and Strategy to drive sustainable user and revenue growth in international markets.
   

  

 As the Country Manager for Argentina, you will be the main point of contact and the driving force behind Canva’s success in the country. You will own and implement a multi\-year strategic roadmap, leading cross\-functional efforts to grow the user base and scale revenue.
   

  

 This role requires deep market knowledge, a growth mindset, and strong leadership capabilities to bring together local and global teams across marketing, sales, and product in a cohesive strategy.
   

  

**What's in it for you?**
 Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard \- and we do \- but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.
   

  

**Here's a Taste Of What's On Offer**
* Equity packages \- we want our success to be yours too
* Inclusive parental leave policy
* An annual Vibe \& Thrive package to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup \& more
* Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally


 Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.
   

  

**Other Stuff To Know**
 We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

title: Sr Brand Design Manager

description:

 Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first\-of\-its\-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready\-to\-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.
   

  

 Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever\-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission:
 **empower Chefs to nourish the world.**
 If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.
   

  

**About The Team**
 At CookUnity, the Brand Marketing team is responsible for developing and executing world\-class marketing activations and experiences that drive brand awareness and earn loyalty beyond reason. This team sets the vision and strategy for the brand and brings it to life with strategic rigor, creative excellence, and cultural relevance. Through insight\-inspired, data\-informed brand storytelling and experiences, CookUnity’s Brand Marketing team will build a category\-defining brand loved by an entire generation of foodies.
   

  

**The Role**
 CookUnity is seeking a seasoned brand design manager to take our creative function to the next level — elevating design craft, modernizing design operations, and boldly differentiating the CookUnity brand. In this role you will oversee the development and expression of the brand visual identity across all consumer touch points, both online and offline, while managing and actively leveling up a team of talented, ambitious designers.
   

  

 Through your leadership and vision, you will build and scale a world\-class brand design function with customer obsession and creative excellence at its core. The ideal candidate brings not only a mastery of design craft honed at best\-in\-class consumer brands, but also the operational rigor to implement new standards of design process and team performance — and the forward\-thinking mindset to leverage AI tools as a high\-impact lever for quality and efficiency.
   

  

 This is a role for a leader who sets the bar high, builds the systems to meet it, and brings a team along for the journey. Reporting to the VP of Brand Marketing, this role is uniquely positioned to create an impact that helps CookUnity resonate emotionally and grow commercially in unprecedented ways.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Creative Vision \& Brand Stewardship**
* Develop and evangelize an inspiring creative vision for the future of CookUnity and help the organization make progress towards achieving its full potential
* Lead the Brand Design team to bring the essence of CookUnity to life through a differentiated design system and visual storytelling across website, app, social media, advertising, CRM, and a growing ecosystem of packaging
* Own, refine, and continue to build on the CookUnity brand identity and visual system as a living resource that evolves with new learnings and insights to better support the needs of the customer and company
* Bring the standards and instincts of best\-in\-class consumer brands to CookUnity — championing unwavering expectations for design craft, quality, and executional consistency


**Design Process \& Operational Excellence**
* Design and manage an ambitious, end\-to\-end creative process — including intake, internal creative reviews, stakeholder feedback cycles, and approval workflows — that ensures consistently on\-time delivery of high\-quality assets
* Lead regular creative reviews of all ongoing design work to provide timely feedback and coaching, and ensure pixel\-perfect execution across all design deliverables
* Lead the routing, feedback, and approval process for brand design deliverables to executive staff and Founder as needed for high\-visibility, high\-impact initiatives


**AI Integration \& Design Innovation**
* Champion the integration of AI\-based tools into the team's design workflows, identifying high\-impact opportunities to automate repeatable tasks, accelerate production, and free the team to focus on higher\-order creative work
* Stay ahead of the rapidly evolving AI tooling landscape and serve as an internal resource for best practices, responsible use, and practical application within a brand design context
* Foster a team culture that embraces experimentation with emerging tools while maintaining the quality standards and creative integrity the brand demands


**Team Leadership \& Talent Development**
* Mentor and motivate a small but mighty team of talented designers, actively leveling up individual skills through structured feedback, coaching, and growth\-oriented development conversations
* Build a culture of trust, openness, accountability, and a relentless pursuit of design excellence — where high standards are a shared value, not just a directive
* Lead by doing: maintain mastery of the tools the team uses daily (Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Claude Design, and relevant AI design tools) and be willing to roll up your sleeves alongside the team when needed


**Cross\-Functional Partnership**
* Partner with teammates, peers, and key stakeholders to proactively identify opportunities or challenges, and take a leadership role in bringing tangible design solutions forward
* Partner directly with brand copy team to define visual storytelling approach, ensuring consistency and deep integration between these teams to maximize efficiency and effectiveness of all creative output
* Assume a strong company presence as an internal standard\-bearer of category\-defining creativity, building trust, alignment, and influence across the organization
* Bring principles of design thinking, a solution\-oriented mindset, and an entrepreneurial spirit to achieving impactful results without depending on significant resources


**Minimum Requirements**
* 8\+ years experience in brand design; experience in top consumer brands and/or agencies is a plus
* 4\+ years managing other designers
* A respected brand design leader with a track record of shipping excellent work and a portfolio demonstrating a mastery of design craft across multiple disciplines of design
* Proficiency in video and how to leverage design in this format is a plus
* Passion for insights and performance data in shaping creative work and a commitment to building a culture that embraces these essential inputs
* Experience operating in a fast\-paced growth environment, including dealing with ambiguity, shifting priorities \& rapid iteration
* Very detail oriented, well organized, and a proven ability to effectively manage multiple projects, work streams, or initiatives simultaneously
* Highly collaborative in nature with ability to partner across various functions throughout a company and demonstrate flexible decision\-making based on new insight or feedback
* A genuine passion for design and a love of the creative process
* Proficiency in English at an advanced level
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, or a related field is a plus


**Learn More About CookUnity**
 We believe great leadership starts with alignment on vision, values, and ways of working. To give you deeper insight into who we are and what we’re looking for, we invite you to explore: CookUnity's Leadership Principles – The values and behaviors that guide how we operate, collaborate, and scale.
   

  

 We hope this provides valuable insight into our culture and product vision. If this excites you, we’d love to connect!
   

  

**Benefits**
 💸 Get paid in USD
   

  

 🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want.
   

  

 ⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date.
   

  

 🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays.
   

  

 🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3\-5 days each time the need arises.

 🧘🏽‍♀️ Flexible benefits, your way: a prepaid card you can use on wellness, learning, food, and more.
   

  

 🤖 AI\-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.
   

  

 🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you.
 **Thank you for your time!**

 . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.*

We Also Want You To Know That We Take This Seriously — Sometimes, As Part Of Our Process, We May Ask For a Brief “proof Of Humanity” To Confirm That We’re Connecting With a Real Person, Not An Impersonator. title: GENERAL MANAGER / MANAGING DIRECTOR — SAVVY SMART DEALS
description:
**GENERAL MANAGER / MANAGING DIRECTOR — SAVVY SMART DEALS**  

**Location:** Remote  

**Type:** Full\-Time, Senior Executive  

**Industry:** Global E\-Commerce, DTC Consumer Products, Performance Marketing

 **THE ROLE**



Savvy Smart Deals is looking for a senior ecommerce operator to run the business end to end.

  

This is not a traditional General Manager role, and it is not a fit for someone whose background is primarily corporate operations, manufacturing, retail, consulting, brand marketing or supply chain.

  

YOU MUST HAVE REAL ECOMMERCE EXPERIENCE.

  

You must understand how to profitably run an online consumer business from product selection through customer acquisition, conversion, fulfillment and customer service.

 **You will own:**


* P\&L, revenue, margin and profit
* Ecommerce strategy and execution
* Product strategy and sourcing
* Online marketing and customer acquisition
* Paid media, affiliate traffic and performance marketing
* Shopify and direct\-response funnels
* Pricing, offers, bundles and upsells
* Conversion rate, AOV, CAC/CPA, ROAS and LTV
* Inventory, purchasing and forecasting
* Warehousing, fulfillment and logistics
* Customer service, refunds and chargebacks
* Budgets, analytics and forecasting
* Team performance and growth

  

You will effectively operate Savvy as the business owner and be responsible for turning products into profitable, scalable ecommerce businesses.

 **NON\-NEGOTIABLE EXPERIENCE**



Candidates must have meaningful hands\-on experience in ALL of the following areas:

 **1\. ECOMMERCE / DTC**  

* Personally operated or materially scaled an ecommerce or DTC business
* Strong understanding of Shopify, Amazon, marketplaces and/or direct\-response ecommerce
* Understand the full online customer journey from traffic through purchase, fulfillment and repeat purchase
 **2\. ONLINE MARKETING**  

* Strong practical knowledge of performance marketing
* Paid media, affiliates, publishers, media buyers or traffic partners
* Understand CPA/CAC, ROAS, RPC, CVR, AOV and LTV
* Experience improving offers, landing pages, checkout, creative, bundles, upsells and conversion
* Able to decide quickly whether to scale, change or stop an offer based on economics
 **3\. LOGISTICS \& INVENTORY**  

* Inventory planning and purchasing
* Demand forecasting
* Stockouts and excess inventory
* Supplier coordination
* Warehousing and fulfillment
* Shipping and logistics
* Working\-capital implications of inventory decisions
 **4\. CUSTOMER SERVICE**  

* Experience managing customer\-service operations in an ecommerce environment
* Understand refunds, returns, chargebacks, complaints and service levels
* Able to identify customer\-service problems that are hurting conversion, retention or profitability
* Experience building or managing processes that improve customer satisfaction while controlling cost
 **BUSINESS \& P\&L**


* Own revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, profit, budgets and forecasts
* Manage marketing spend and operating costs
* Review business performance frequently and take corrective action quickly
* Ensure every major product and channel has clear unit economics
* Manage cash and working capital with discipline

 **PRODUCTS \& SOURCING**


* Continuously identify strong new product opportunities
* Evaluate demand, competition, margin and scalability
* Work directly with suppliers and sourcing teams
* Negotiate price, MOQ, terms, production and lead times
* Understand landed COGS
* Manage product launches and seasonal planning
* Decide what to launch, scale, improve or discontinue

 **MARKETING, TRAFFIC \& OFFERS**


* Own positioning and offer strategy
* Approve pricing, bundles, discounts, upsells and recurring\-revenue opportunities
* Direct landing pages, advertorials, checkout, creative and video strategy
* Build relationships with affiliate networks, publishers, media buyers and traffic partners
* Negotiate payouts and commercial terms
* Secure profitable traffic at scale
* Expand winning offers into new channels and geographies

 **INVENTORY, FULFILLMENT \& CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE**


* Own inventory planning and purchasing decisions
* Prevent stockouts and excessive inventory
* Improve monetization of existing inventory through offers, bundles and upsells
* Coordinate suppliers, warehouses, fulfillment and logistics partners
* Ensure fulfillment problems do not interrupt sales
* Own customer\-service performance, returns, refunds and chargebacks
* Ensure service issues are identified and fixed quickly

 **PERFORMANCE \& ANALYTICS**



You must actively understand and manage:


* Revenue
* Gross margin
* Contribution margin
* Net profit
* CPA/CAC
* ROAS
* RPC
* CVR
* AOV
* Affiliate payouts
* Payment approval rates
* Refunds and chargebacks
* Inventory levels and turns
* Recurring revenue
* Customer lifetime value
* Customer\-service KPIs



Decisions must be based on economics and data, not opinion.

 **WHO WE WANT**



We want a proven owner\-type ecommerce operator, not a corporate administrator.



The ideal candidate has already run, built or materially scaled an ecommerce, DTC or direct\-response consumer\-products business and understands both sides of the business:

 **CUSTOMER ACQUISITION \+ OPERATIONS**



That means you must be comfortable moving in the same day between:


* Reviewing CPA and ROAS
* Improving an offer or funnel
* Negotiating with a supplier
* Reviewing inventory and forecasts
* Fixing a fulfillment problem
* Reviewing customer\-service issues
* Managing the P\&L

  

Strong candidates will have:


* Senior leadership experience
* Direct P\&L responsibility
* Proven ecommerce/DTC operating experience
* Strong online performance\-marketing knowledge
* Experience launching and scaling products
* Strong sourcing and supplier\-negotiation experience
* Inventory and logistics experience
* Customer\-service management experience
* Shopify/direct\-response experience
* Strong financial and analytical ability
* Strong technology and practical AI skills
* Excellent English

  

International ecommerce, Asian sourcing, Amazon, affiliate marketing, recurring revenue and payment optimization are strong advantages.

 **THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF**


* You have never run or materially scaled ecommerce
* Your experience is primarily offline retail, manufacturing or traditional corporate operations
* You know brand marketing but not performance marketing
* You cannot explain CPA, ROAS, CVR, AOV and LTV
* You have never dealt with inventory, fulfillment or logistics
* You have never managed customer\-service performance, refunds or chargebacks
* You prefer managing through meetings rather than making fast commercial decisions

 **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**



Success means building Savvy into a larger, more profitable global ecommerce business through:


* Strong new products
* Profitable online traffic
* Faster launches
* Better conversion
* Higher AOV and LTV
* Strong sourcing and margins
* Excellent inventory management
* Reliable fulfillment
* Better customer service
* Lower refunds and chargebacks
* Accurate forecasting
* Consistent testing and optimization
* Increasing revenue and profit

 **WHY JOIN**



This is an opportunity to run an entire ecommerce business, not one department.

  

You will have significant authority, direct access to ownership, strong internal resources and meaningful performance\-based upside.

  

If you have already built, operated or scaled an ecommerce business and want full responsibility for the outcome, we want to speak with you.

Founded in 2018, Vets Choice Radiology (VCR) is a leading full\-service veterinary teleradiology company known for diagnostic quality, white\-glove service, and guaranteed turnaround times. With a global network of more than 100 board\-certified veterinary radiologists, VCR provides 24/7/365 interpretation services for radiographs, ultrasound, CT, and MRI, backed by a one\-hour STAT guarantee or the read is free.


We are in an exciting phase of growth, investing in people, technology, and infrastructure to strengthen patient care and meet the evolving needs of the veterinary profession.

**Vets Choice Radiology is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate. All employment decisions are based upon qualifications, merit, and business need.**

**Job Summary**


The Director of Marketing (Contract) leads VCR’s marketing function — covering both our core B2B teleradiology services as well as our emerging B2B Software Business, across digital, print, social, product and direct marketing — translating company strategy into integrated, multi\-channel programs. This is a player\-coach role: the Director personally executes core marketing programs today while laying the foundation for a growing marketing team over time. Reporting directly to the CEO, the Director of Marketing owns brand consistency and channel strategy across the marketing mix.

**Essential Job Functions**

* Manage VCR’s social media presence and content calendar across relevant platforms.
* Lead direct marketing efforts targeting veterinary practices, including outreach campaigns and lead\-generation programs.

* Partner with the Art Director and other creative contributors to bring campaigns to life visually.

* Build and lead VCR’s marketing team over time as the function scales, starting in a hands\-on individual\-contributor capacity.
* Foster a high\-performance marketing culture built on creativity, accountability, and continuous improvement as the team grows.

* Familiarity with the veterinary profession and B2B software / healthcare marketing; comfort creating content and messaging for DVMs, practice managers, and other veterinary decision\-makers.
* Comfortable operating as a hands\-on individual contributor while also building and mentoring a team over time, in a fast\-paced remote environment; track record of strong cross\-functional partnerships.

**Cognitive and Physical Demands**

title: Senior Director, Content, Social, Creator Marketing
description:
**What the Role Is**



Babylist's brand carries the emotional weight of one of the biggest transitions in a person's life and Babylist's community is already talking about their experience by creating content and sharing it. We have already built a strong foundation across social and are already the number one baby brand on Tik Tok. At the same time, we have not turned our content into real programs yet. This is a new role, reporting directly to the CMO, that owns editorial, social, creator and influencer marketing, community, branded content, and Babylist's podcasts. This role will lead the full range of channels where content actually reaches expectant and new parents and the community around them. You'll lead a team already doing strong work in pieces, and your job is to give it a point of view and a growth plan. This is a builder's job: Babylist sits at 15% aided brand awareness with over 75 NPS. We are loved by many but have real headroom to close the awareness gap, and that's the mandate. To do this, we will be investing more in demand generation content with paid media to reach the right audiences. This role will shape the creative direction, messaging, outcomes and learning for this work. Babylist's community is already talking about their experience — creating content, sharing it, trusting each other's voices more than any ad. Nobody owns turning that into a real program yet. The work will be structured around Marketing's role in driving new customer acquisition and unlocking more value from the customers we already have.


**Who You Are**


* **You've built a creator or influencer program from close to zero** — the affiliate mechanics, the relationships, the content frameworks and not just managed one that already existed.
* **You know social\-native video as a craft.** You understand why a 90\-second TikTok and a brand film are different disciplines, and can lead both without flattening either. You get channel specificity and how to set outcome driven KPI's and continually test and iterate.
* **You've led editorial and commercial content living side by side** and know how to protect editorial trust while still making sponsored content genuinely good.
* **You think in community, not just channels.** You know how to turn people who already love a product into the people who make content about it across a series of topics that matter to the audience.
* **You can run a multi\-format content team** — written, video, audio, social — and know when a story belongs in which format and work to share learnings across formats and channels to maximize efficacy.
* **You have led social teams that build content from the bottom of the funnel up \-** you seed content through organic and know when to amplify it with paid and update the format to move it up the funnel to create consideration across addressable channels like YouTube and addressable TV.
* **You are outcome driven \-** you will establish frameworks to ensure we know what is actually working and understand how to measure success across channel KPI's and how to understand the funnel and impact to performance metrics.
* You naturally reach for AI in your work — at Babylist, every team uses AI daily. You're already using it to move faster and improve your output, and you stay curious about what's coming next.


**How You Will Make An Impact**


* Own Babylist's editorial and branded content, brand social presence, creator and influencer marketing, community program, and podcasts.
* Establish our showrooms as a hub for brand and user content leveraging our in house studio in the NYC showroom.
* Build Babylist's affiliate creator and influencer program from the ground up: recruitment, program mechanics, and the content frameworks that make it scale.
* Lead the team directly responsible for execution: Director, Social, Community \& Creators; Senior Manager, Editorial Content; Senior Manager, Branded Content; and the Podcast Producer.
* Own social\-native video as Babylist's highest\-frequency, highest\-performing content format, while partnering with Brand Strategy \& Creative Studio on where brand\-level video lives instead.
* Set the standard for how editorial integrity and sponsored content coexist on the same team — through process and disclosure, not separate fiefdoms.
* Partner with Integrated Marketing leads on content needs for major go\-to\-market moments, and with Brand Strategy \& Creative Studio on the handshake between campaign creative and channel content.
* You understand culture and the role of establishing a content calendar with tentpole moments and when to hijack culture when a moment where we have the right to win plays out.


**Why This Role**


* You will build on the content foundations and establish more efficiency and cross channel collaboration. You will set the operating model and drive comprehension and collaboration across teams.
* You will streamline creative production and refine our approach to what we build versus where we partner.
* You report directly to the CMO, with real ownership over the channels expectant and new parents actually spend time in.
* Babylist's community is an underused asset. Millions of families already creating content about their experience, with no infrastructure yet to turn that into a real program. You'd be the one who builds it.
* Video and creator marketing are the two highest\-leverage growth levers in the current plan and you are inventing Babylist's playbook to do this work.


**About Compensation**



We use a market\-based approach to compensation. The starting salary range for this role is:


**$212,712 to $283,694 \+ target 25% annual bonus and competitive equity**



Your starting salary will be based on your location, experience, and qualifications, with increases over time tied to performance, role growth, and internal pay equity.


**Who We Are**



Babylist is the leading platform for expecting and new families. More than 10 million people shop with Babylist every year, making it the go\-to destination for seamless purchasing, guidance, and expert recommendations. As a modern, AI\-forward tech company, Babylist has expanded from a universal registry into a full ecosystem — the Babylist Shop, Babylist Health, Babylist Money, NYC and LA showrooms, branded content, and more — generating $750M in revenue in 2025\. Building the generational brand in baby, Babylist is reshaping the $235B kids and baby market and helping parents feel confident, connected, and cared for at every step.


**Our Ways of Working**



Babylist is remote\-first with team members across the U.S. and Canada who move fast, think smart, and use AI as part of how they work every day — not as an experiment, as an expectation. We come together twice a year to build the relationships behind the work, and we hire people who are genuinely excited about what's possible and prove it through how they show up.


**Why You Will Love Working At Babylist**


**Our Culture**


* We work with focus and intention, then step away to recharge
* We believe in exceptional management, and we invest in the tools and the time to connect with colleagues
* We build products that positively impact millions of people's lives
* AI is part of how we work, not a side experiment. You'll have leading tools like Claude and ChatGPT from day one, with no waiting on access, so the busywork gets handled and your judgment goes where it counts


**Growth \& Development**


* Competitive pay and meaningful opportunities for career advancement
* We believe technology and data can solve hard problems
* We're committed to career progression and performance\-based advancement


**Benefits**


* Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Retirement savings plan with company matching and flexible spending accounts
* Generous paid parental leave and PTO
* Winter Wonder Week: the whole company takes a paid week off at the end of the year, whether or not you celebrate anything, so everyone's out at once and comes back refreshed
* Remote work stipend to set up your office
* Perks for physical, mental, and emotional health, parenting, childcare, and financial planning

  


### **Important Notices**


**Recorded Interviews.** Babylist uses an interview recording tool to record and transcribe interviews for evaluation purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. By participating in an interview, you consent to this recording and transcription.


**Interview Integrity.** AI is part of how we work at Babylist. We expect you to use it too. Your application and interviews should still reflect you and your own thinking. We'll tell you when AI is encouraged. Misrepresentation at any stage may result in removal from consideration for this and future roles.


**How We Review Applications** We use AI throughout our hiring process to help review, screen, and assess applications. These tools support our team's review; they do not replace it, and every hiring decision is made by a person.


**Connections at Babylist.** If you have a family member or close personal relationship with a current Babylist employee, please let your recruiter know. This helps us keep our process fair and transparent for everyone.


**Protect Yourself from Scams.** All official outreach comes from the Babylist Talent Team via @babylist.com email addresses only. We will never ask for payment or personal financial information. If you receive outreach via WhatsApp, Telegram, or a non\-Babylist email, it's not us. Verify open roles at babylist.com/careers.

title: Director, Brand & Integrated Marketing
description:
The Director of Brand \& Integrated Marketing will own MeUndies’ overall brand strategy and translate it into a cohesive marketing calendar, compelling campaigns, culturally relevant content, and consistent execution across every customer touchpoint. This leader will oversee the Brand and Social teams while owning integrated campaign planning, product\-launch briefing, content strategy, influencer and affiliate strategy, licensing marketing, and brand partnerships. This is not a role for someone who only develops high\-level strategy or manages agencies. We are looking for a hands\-on leader who can set the vision, write a strong brief, lead teams through execution, make decisions quickly, and measure what worked.
   

  

 This role will work closely with Creative, Growth, Retention, E\-commerce, Merchandising, Product, Wholesale, and Licensing to ensure the entire organization is working from one clear brand and commercial calendar.
   

  

****Please note that this is a hybrid position of 4 days/week in our Los Angeles office.****
**What You'll Do**
* Brand Strategy and Positioning
* Own and evolve the MeUndies brand strategy, positioning, voice, visual identity, and cultural point of view.
* Ensure the brand remains distinctive, relevant, emotionally resonant, and consistent across DTC, retail, wholesale, and licensed products.
* Translate company and commercial priorities into clear customer\-facing narratives.
* Maintain and evolve brand guidelines while ensuring teams and external partners apply them consistently.
* Protect long\-term brand equity while helping the company achieve near\-term revenue goals.


 Integrated Marketing Calendar
   

  

* Own the master MeUndies marketing calendar across product launches, promotions, seasonal moments, collaborations, licensing, retail, and cultural opportunities.
* Create one source of truth connecting Brand, Creative, Growth, Retention, E\-commerce, Merchandising, Product, and Wholesale.
* Lead cross\-functional planning meetings and ensure teams understand the objective, audience, message, deliverables, owners, deadlines, and success metrics for every major initiative.
* Identify calendar conflicts, missed opportunities, and resource constraints early.


 Campaigns and Product Launches
   

  

* Lead the end\-to\-end go\-to\-market process for major campaigns, product launches, collaborations, and licensed collections.
* Develop sharp, actionable briefs grounded in customer insight, business goals, channel needs, and a clear creative proposition.
* Ensure briefs include the audience, insight, objective, positioning, key message, deliverables, channel strategy, timing, budget, and measurement plan.
* Partner with Creative to develop concepts that are both brand\-building and commercially effective.
* Maintain launch readiness and hold cross\-functional teams accountable to deadlines and deliverables.


 Content and Social Strategy
   

  

* Own the integrated content strategy across organic social, campaigns, editorial, community, creators, partnerships, and emerging channels.
* Lead the Social team and establish clear channel roles, content pillars, publishing cadence, and platform\-specific strategies.
* Build a content engine that allows MeUndies to respond quickly to cultural moments without losing brand consistency.
* Balance polished campaign content with creator\-led, community\-driven, educational, entertaining, and conversion\-oriented content.
* Establish a disciplined testing and learning process for formats, messages, talent, and platforms.


 Influencer, Creator, and Affiliate Strategy
   

  

* Own the strategy for influencers, creators, ambassadors, affiliates, and other external brand advocates.
* Develop a clear approach to seeding, paid partnerships, long\-term creator relationships, performance affiliates, and brand ambassadors.
* Build programs that generate both culturally relevant content and measurable customer acquisition.
* Partner with Growth to define channel economics, attribution, testing budgets, and performance expectations.
* Identify creators and partners who authentically represent the MeUndies customer and brand values.


 Licensing, Collaborations, and Partnerships
   

  

* Lead the marketing strategy for entertainment licenses, collaborations, and strategic brand partnerships.
* Partner with Product, Merchandising, Creative, Legal, and licensors from concept through launch.
* Develop a balanced licensing calendar that can drive customer acquisition and revenue without overwhelming the core MeUndies brand.
* Identify new collaboration and partnership opportunities that expand cultural relevance, audience reach, and commercial potential.
* Ensure all licensed marketing meets partner requirements while still feeling unmistakably MeUndies.


 Consumer Insights and Cultural Relevance
   

  

* Build a strong understanding of the MeUndies customer through research, social listening, reviews, community feedback, competitive analysis, and performance data.
* Translate customer and cultural insights into actionable campaign, product, and content opportunities.
* Track cultural shifts, category trends, emerging platforms, and competitor activity.
* Serve as the internal voice of the customer and help teams understand what is changing in the market.


 Brand Communications and Community
   

  

* Partner with internal and external resources on PR, earned media, founder communications, events, and brand reputation.
* Develop strategies that deepen customer participation, advocacy, and community.
* Identify opportunities for experiential marketing, events, pop\-ups, and earned cultural moments.
* Help shape how MeUndies responds to sensitive cultural, customer, or reputational issues.


 Measurement and Hindsights
   

  

* Establish clear success metrics before every campaign and launch.
* Lead formal post\-launch hindsights that assess creative performance, channel performance, customer response, operational execution, and commercial results.
* Turn findings into specific changes for future campaigns instead of simply reporting results.
* Develop a brand\-health measurement framework covering awareness, consideration, sentiment, engagement, customer growth, and brand relevance.
* Partner with Growth and Finance to understand incrementality, return on marketing investment, and the relationship between brand activity and revenue.


 Leadership and Operations
   

  

* Lead, develop, and hold accountable the Brand and Social teams.
* Build clear workflows, decision rights, timelines, and standards for excellent execution.
* Manage relevant agencies, freelancers, creators, production partners, and brand budgets.
* Prioritize resources across competing initiatives and maintain a high bar for quality, speed, and accountability.
* Present strategies, plans, results, and recommendations to senior leadership.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* MeUndies operates from one clear and reliable integrated marketing calendar.
* Every major launch begins with a strong brief, launches on time, and concludes with a useful hindsight.
* The brand has a more recognizable and culturally relevant point of view.
* Social and content become more consistent, responsive, and commercially effective.
* Influencer and affiliate programs have clear strategies, economics, and measurement.
* Licensing and collaborations support both revenue growth and long\-term brand equity.
* Cross\-functional teams have clearer priorities, ownership, and deadlines.
* Brand investment is measured with the same discipline as performance marketing.


**What You Have**
* 8–12\+ years of brand, integrated marketing, or consumer marketing experience, ideally within a modern DTC, apparel, lifestyle, beauty, or consumer brand.
* Experience leading brand strategy and integrated campaigns across multiple channels.
* Demonstrated success building marketing calendars and launching products, collaborations, or licensed collections.
* Strong understanding of organic social, creators, influencers, affiliates, partnerships, and content development.
* Ability to connect brand\-building activity with commercial performance.
* Excellent briefing, storytelling, presentation, and written communication skills.
* Strong understanding of consumer insights, cultural trends, and modern customer behavior.
* Experience managing teams, agencies, budgets, and complex cross\-functional projects.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment with high expectations and limited bureaucracy.
* Willingness to work at both the strategic and executional levels.


**The base salary range for this full\-time position is $125,000\-$150,000\. Within this range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the base salary range provided in this posting does not include any bonus, equity, or benefits you may be eligible for.**
****WHY WORK AT MEUNDIES?****
****It's more than a job.****
 We have focused on building a team of people who emulate our core values. We look for people who stay balanced, go further, build relationships, champion differences, and are humble. At MeUndies, we continue to maintain a stellar brand by working collaboratively and encouraging growth with learning opportunities. There is no such thing as a small achievement here \- we celebrate it all!
   

  

****We look at the necessities.****
 We offer competitive salary packages, including targeted annual bonuses, generous parental leave, a 401k, fantastic health benefits, open time off, and more.
   

  

****We have an office you’ll enjoy going to.****
 We work in our office Monday \- Thursday. Friday is a remote/work\-from\-home day. We’re set up to support comfortable working \- hot desks, lounge, and casual seating areas, a Mother’s Room, an on\-site gym \& shower, and a kitchen that makes you feel like you’ve never left home. We’re dog\-friendly, so your furry coworker can join you anytime.
   

  

****We don’t forget the most important things.****
 We want MeUndies to be a place where you feel safe and comfortable, and we encourage our employees to hold us accountable for keeping it that way. We encourage open communication and a People Ops team that is ready to help. When you work at MeUndies, we take your needs as an employee (and a person) seriously. Our doors are always welcome to feedback and suggestions!
   

  

****Plus those special extra things.****
 We also know how important it is to connect with your team members outside of everyday work. We offer catered lunches every in\-office day, holiday parties, off\-sites, happy hours, and an annual retreat. You’ll also get a sweet employee discount to rebuild your underwear drawer with our top\-notch prints.

You own how Lotus Plant Power shows up in the world.

seasonal timelines — you've run a creative engine at this pace and kept the bar high.

A systems builder. You don't just make great work once; you build the templates, guidelines,
